# Doel van dit deel

Voordat we aan de geavanceerde statistiek beginnen moeten drie dingen op orde zijn:

1.  **Pack-years koppelen** als continue blootstellingsmaat.
2.  **Demografie bulletproof beschrijven** — inclusief confounders (leeftijd, astma, pack-years) per rookgroep, met formele toetsen.
3.  **PC biologische duiding** — welke CpGs drijven PC1, PC2, PC3? En welke klinische variabelen correleren ermee?



```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(limma)
library(minfi)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)
```

# Data inladen

```{r}
clinical_raw <- read_csv("RNA_DNA_Meth_ids_clinical.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
methylation_raw <- fread("batch_plate_corrected_beta_Noob_BMIQ.csv.gz")

meth_matrix <- as.matrix(methylation_raw[, -1])
rownames(meth_matrix) <- methylation_raw$V1

matched_samples <- clinical_raw %>%
  filter(meth_file_id %in% colnames(meth_matrix))

methylation <- meth_matrix[, matched_samples$meth_file_id]
clinical <- as.data.frame(matched_samples)
rownames(clinical) <- clinical$meth_file_id

clinical$smoking_cat <- factor(clinical$smoking.status,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker"))
clinical$gender  <- factor(clinical$gender)
clinical$chip_id <- substr(rownames(clinical), 1, 12)

cat("Samples:", ncol(methylation), " | CpGs:", nrow(methylation), "\n")
```

## Koppelen van "pack years"

```{r}
packyears <- read_csv("extracted_packyears.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

clinical$PACKNO <- packyears$PACKNO[
  match(clinical$meth_file_id, packyears$meth_file_id)
]

cat("Samples zonder pack-years:", sum(is.na(clinical$PACKNO)), "\n\n")

clinical %>%
  group_by(smoking_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(PACKNO)),
    mediaan   = median(PACKNO, na.rm = TRUE),
    gemiddeld = round(mean(PACKNO, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min = min(PACKNO, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(PACKNO, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% print()
```

```{r}
cat("Never-smokers met PACKNO > 0 (zou 0 moeten zijn):",

cat("Current/Ex-smokers met PACKNO = 0 (verdacht):",
```

### Demographic table

```{r}
clinical %>%
  group_by(smoking_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age_median  = median(age),
    age_iqr     = paste(quantile(age, 0.25), "-", quantile(age, 0.75)),

                        quantile(PACKNO, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% print()

cat("\nGeslacht per rookgroep:\n")
print(addmargins(table(Geslacht = clinical$gender, Rookstatus = clinical$smoking_cat)))

cat("\nAstma per rookgroep:\n")
```

```{r}
kw_age <- kruskal.test(age ~ smoking_cat, data = clinical)
cat("Leeftijd ~ rookstatus (Kruskal-Wallis): H =", round(kw_age$statistic, 2),
    ", p =", format.pval(kw_age$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")

cat("Post-hoc Wilcoxon (Bonferroni):\n")
print(pairwise.wilcox.test(clinical$age, clinical$smoking_cat,
                           p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"))

wilcox_pack <- wilcox.test(PACKNO ~ smoking_cat,
  data = clinical %>% filter(smoking_cat != "Non.smoker"))
cat("\nPack-years ex vs current (Wilcoxon): W =", round(wilcox_pack$statistic, 1),
    ", p =", format.pval(wilcox_pack$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")

chi_gender <- chisq.test(table(clinical$gender, clinical$smoking_cat))
cat("Geslacht ~ rookstatus: X² =", round(chi_gender$statistic, 2),
    ", p =", format.pval(chi_gender$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")

chi_asthma <- chisq.test(table(clinical$asthma.status, clinical$smoking_cat))
cat("Astma ~ rookstatus: X² =", round(chi_asthma$statistic, 2),
    ", p =", format.pval(chi_asthma$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
has_na <- rowSums(is.na(methylation)) > 0
cat("CpGs met NA uitgesloten:", sum(has_na), "\n")

meth_complete <- methylation[!has_na, ]
var_cpg <- rowVars(meth_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
top_var <- order(var_cpg, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5000]

pca <- prcomp(t(meth_complete[top_var, ]), scale. = TRUE)
var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:10] * 100

cat("Variantie per PC:\n"); print(round(var_exp, 2))
```

```{r}
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:10])
pca_scores$smoking_cat <- clinical$smoking_cat
pca_scores$gender      <- clinical$gender
pca_scores$age         <- clinical$age
pca_scores$asthma      <- factor(clinical$asthma.status)
pca_scores$pack        <- clinical$PACKNO
pca_scores$chip_id     <- factor(clinical$chip_id)

assoc_df <- data.frame()
for (pc in paste0("PC", 1:10)) {
  r2_age  <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ age,  data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_pack <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ pack, data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_smok <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ smoking_cat, data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_gend <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ gender,      data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_asth <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ asthma,      data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_chip <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ chip_id,     data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  assoc_df <- rbind(assoc_df, data.frame(PC = pc,
    Smoking = r2_smok, Gender = r2_gend, Age = r2_age,
    Asthma = r2_asth, PackYears = r2_pack, Chip = r2_chip))
}

assoc_long <- assoc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-PC, names_to = "Variabele", values_to = "R2")
assoc_long$PC <- factor(assoc_long$PC, levels = paste0("PC", 1:10))

ggplot(assoc_long, aes(x = PC, y = Variabele, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", R2)),
            color = ifelse(assoc_long$R2 > 0.5, "white", "black"), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b",
                      limits = c(0, 1), name = expression(R^2)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Associatie PCs × klinische variabelen",
       subtitle = "R² uit univariate regressie — hoger = sterker verband",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
loadings <- pca$rotation[, 1:3]
cpg_names <- rownames(meth_complete)[top_var]
rownames(loadings) <- cpg_names

anno <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)

annoteer_cpgs <- function(df) {
  cpg_clean <- sub("_.*", "", df$CpG)
  idx <- match(cpg_clean, rownames(anno))
  df$Gene   <- gsub(";.*", "", anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx])
  df$Chr    <- anno$chr[idx]
  df$Island <- anno$Relation_to_Island[idx]
  df
}

top_per_pc <- list()
for (pc in c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")) {
  top_idx <- order(abs(loadings[, pc]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:30]
  df <- data.frame(
    CpG      = cpg_names[top_idx],
    loading  = loadings[top_idx, pc],
    abs_load = abs(loadings[top_idx, pc])
  )
  df <- annoteer_cpgs(df)
  top_per_pc[[pc]] <- df

  cat("\n=== TOP 10 CpGs —", pc, "===\n")
  print(head(df[, c("CpG", "loading", "Gene", "Chr", "Island")], 10))

  write.csv(df, paste0("top_loadings_", pc, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
library(EpiDISH)
data(centEpiFibIC.m)

meth_clean <- methylation
rownames(meth_clean) <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(meth_clean))

out <- epidish(beta.m = meth_clean, ref.m = centEpiFibIC.m, method = "RPC")

clinical$Epi <- out$estF[match(rownames(clinical), rownames(out$estF)), "Epi"]
clinical$IC  <- out$estF[match(rownames(clinical), rownames(out$estF)), "IC"]
```

```{r}
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[,1], PC2 = pca$x[,2], PC3 = pca$x[,3],
  smoking = clinical$smoking_cat,
  gender  = clinical$gender,
  age     = clinical$age,
  asthma  = clinical$asthma.status,
  pack    = clinical$PACKNO
)

theme_pca <- theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

g1 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = smoking)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) + stat_ellipse(level = 0.68) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Non.smoker" = "steelblue",
                                "Ex.smoker" = "orange",
                                "Current.smoker" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(title = "PC1 vs PC2 — rookstatus",
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])) + theme_pca

g2 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = gender)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "purple3", "male" = "forestgreen")) +
  labs(title = "PC1 vs PC2 — geslacht",
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])) + theme_pca

g3 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = age)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(title = "PC1 vs PC2 — leeftijd",
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])) + theme_pca

g4 <- ggplot(pca_df %>% filter(!is.na(pack)),
             aes(PC1, PC2, color = pack)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno", trans = "sqrt", name = "Pack-years") +
  labs(title = "PC1 vs PC2 — pack-years",
       x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2])) + theme_pca

(g1 + g2) / (g3 + g4)
```

```{r}
# Age-matched + CT
age_range <- range(clinical$age[clinical$smoking_cat == "Current.smoker"])
clinical_matched2 <- clinical %>%
  filter(smoking_cat %in% c("Non.smoker", "Current.smoker"),
         age >= age_range[1], age <= age_range[2])
clinical_matched2$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clinical_matched2$smoking_cat)
meth_matched2 <- methylation[, rownames(clinical_matched2)]

design_matched2 <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC,
                                data = clinical_matched2)
fit_matched2 <- lmFit(meth_matched2, design_matched2)
fit_matched2 <- eBayes(fit_matched2)
results_matched2 <- topTable(fit_matched2, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PCA FIGUREN — voor presentatie en verslag
# =============================================================================
# Vereist: methylation (beta-matrix), clinical (met Epi, IC, smoking_cat,
#          gender, age, PACKNO), en eventueel chip-ID

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# STAP 1: PCA berekenen op top-5000 variabele CpGs
# =============================================================================

# Selecteer top-5000 meest variabele CpGs
vars <- apply(methylation, 1, var)
top5000 <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:5000]

# PCA (samples als rijen, CpGs als kolommen)
pca_result <- prcomp(t(methylation[top5000, ]), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# Verklaarde variantie per PC
pct_var <- round(100 * (pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2)), 1)

# Maak een dataframe met PCs + klinische data
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_result$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_result$x[, 3],
  PC4 = pca_result$x[, 4],
  PC5 = pca_result$x[, 5]
)
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

# Koppel klinische data
pca_df$Epi         <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "Epi"]
pca_df$IC          <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "IC"]
pca_df$smoking_cat <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "smoking_cat"]
pca_df$gender      <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "gender"]
pca_df$age         <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "age"]
pca_df$pack_years  <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "PACKNO"]

# Chip-ID als je die hebt (pas kolomnaam aan indien nodig)
if ("Sentrix_ID" %in% colnames(clinical)) {
  pca_df$chip <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "Sentrix_ID"]
} else if ("chip" %in% colnames(clinical)) {
  pca_df$chip <- clinical[rownames(pca_df), "chip"]
} else {
  # Probeer uit meth_file_id het chipnummer te halen
  pca_df$chip <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(pca_df))
}

cat("Verklaarde variantie: PC1 =", pct_var[1], "%, PC2 =", pct_var[2], 
    "%, PC3 =", pct_var[3], "%\n")


# =============================================================================
# FIGUUR 1 (HOOFDFIGUUR): PCA gekleurd op epitheel-proportie
# =============================================================================
# Dit is de figuur voor op de slide — bewijst visueel dat PC1 = celtype

p_epi <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Epi)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Epithelial\nproportion", option = "D") +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
    title = "PCA — gekleurd op epitheel-celtype proportie (EpiDISH)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_epi)
ggsave("PCA_epitheel_proportie.pdf", p_epi, width = 9, height = 6)
ggsave("PCA_epitheel_proportie.png", p_epi, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("Figuur 1 opgeslagen: PCA_epitheel_proportie.pdf/.png\n")


# =============================================================================
# FIGUUR 2: R²-heatmap (PCs vs klinische variabelen)
# =============================================================================
# Dit is de kernfiguur die in één beeld toont welke variabele bij welke PC hoort

# Bereken R² voor PC1-PC10 tegen alle klinische variabelen
n_pcs <- 10
r2_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pcs, ncol = 7)
rownames(r2_matrix) <- paste0("PC", 1:n_pcs)
colnames(r2_matrix) <- c("Epi", "IC", "Geslacht", "Leeftijd", 
                          "Rookstatus", "Pack-years", "Chip")

for (i in 1:n_pcs) {
  pc <- pca_result$x[, i]
  
  # Continue variabelen: R² uit lineaire regressie
  r2_matrix[i, "Epi"]      <- summary(lm(pc ~ pca_df$Epi))$r.squared
  r2_matrix[i, "IC"]       <- summary(lm(pc ~ pca_df$IC))$r.squared
  r2_matrix[i, "Leeftijd"] <- summary(lm(pc ~ pca_df$age))$r.squared
  r2_matrix[i, "Pack-years"] <- summary(lm(pc ~ pca_df$pack_years))$r.squared
  
  # Categorische variabelen: R² uit ANOVA (= lineaire regressie met factor)
  r2_matrix[i, "Geslacht"]   <- summary(lm(pc ~ as.factor(pca_df$gender)))$r.squared
  r2_matrix[i, "Rookstatus"] <- summary(lm(pc ~ as.factor(pca_df$smoking_cat)))$r.squared
  r2_matrix[i, "Chip"]       <- summary(lm(pc ~ as.factor(pca_df$chip)))$r.squared
}

# Reshape voor ggplot
r2_long <- as.data.frame(r2_matrix)
r2_long$PC <- rownames(r2_long)
r2_long <- pivot_longer(r2_long, cols = -PC, names_to = "Variabele", values_to = "R2")
r2_long$PC <- factor(r2_long$PC, levels = paste0("PC", 1:n_pcs))
r2_long$Variabele <- factor(r2_long$Variabele, 
                             levels = c("Epi", "IC", "Geslacht", "Leeftijd",
                                        "Rookstatus", "Pack-years", "Chip"))

p_heatmap <- ggplot(r2_long, aes(x = Variabele, y = PC, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", R2)), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", mid = "#4ECDC4", high = "#1B2A4A",
    midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1), name = "R²"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "R²-heatmap: Principale Componenten vs klinische variabelen",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_heatmap)
ggsave("PCA_R2_heatmap.pdf", p_heatmap, width = 9, height = 6)
ggsave("PCA_R2_heatmap.png", p_heatmap, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("Figuur 2 opgeslagen: PCA_R2_heatmap.pdf/.png\n")


# =============================================================================
# FIGUUR 3: Gecombineerd 2x2 panel (voor appendix / backup)
# =============================================================================

# Rookstatus
p_rook <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = smoking_cat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Non.smoker" = "steelblue", "Ex.smoker" = "orange", 
               "Current.smoker" = "firebrick"),
    name = "Rookstatus"
  ) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
       title = "Rookstatus") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

# Geslacht
p_gender <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = gender)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#9B59B6", "male" = "#27AE60"), 
                     name = "Geslacht") +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
       title = "Geslacht") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

# Leeftijd
p_age <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = age)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Leeftijd", option = "B") +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
       title = "Leeftijd") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Immuuncellen
p_ic <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = IC)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "IC proportie", option = "C") +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)"),
       title = "Immuuncel-proportie") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Combineer
p_panel <- (p_rook | p_gender) / (p_age | p_ic) +
```

```{r}
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# STAP 1: Modellen ZONDER celtype-correctie
# =============================================================================

# Selecteer current vs never samples EN drop ongebruikte factor-niveaus
cn_idx <- which(clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Non.smoker", "Current.smoker"))
clin_cn <- clinical[cn_idx, ]
clin_cn$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clin_cn$smoking_cat)  # CRUCIAAL
meth_cn <- methylation[, rownames(clin_cn)]

cat("Samples:", nrow(clin_cn), "| Levels:", levels(clin_cn$smoking_cat), "\n")

# Model ZONDER CT-correctie
design_nocorr <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age, data = clin_cn)
fit_nocorr <- lmFit(meth_cn, design_nocorr)
fit_nocorr <- eBayes(fit_nocorr)
results_nocorr <- topTable(fit_nocorr, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

# Age-matched ZONDER CT-correctie
age_range <- range(clin_cn$age[clin_cn$smoking_cat == "Current.smoker"])
matched_idx <- which(clin_cn$age >= age_range[1] & clin_cn$age <= age_range[2])
clin_matched <- clin_cn[matched_idx, ]
clin_matched$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clin_matched$smoking_cat)
meth_matched <- meth_cn[, rownames(clin_matched)]

cat("Age-matched samples:", nrow(clin_matched), "\n")

design_matched <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age, data = clin_matched)
fit_matched <- lmFit(meth_matched, design_matched)
fit_matched <- eBayes(fit_matched)
results_matched <- topTable(fit_matched, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

cat("Modellen gefit.\n")
cat("DMPs zonder CT:", sum(results_nocorr$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
cat("DMPs age-matched zonder CT:", sum(results_matched$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# STAP 2: QQ-plots
# =============================================================================

qq_data <- function(results, label) {
  pvals <- results$P.Value[!is.na(results$P.Value)]
  pvals <- pvals[pvals > 0]  # verwijder exacte nullen
  n <- length(pvals)
  cat(label, ": n =", n, "p-waarden\n")
  data.frame(
    expected = -log10(sort((1:n) / (n + 1))),
    observed = -log10(sort(pvals)),
    model = label
  )
}

calc_lambda <- function(results) {
  pvals <- results$P.Value[!is.na(results$P.Value)]
  pvals <- pvals[pvals > 0]
  chisq <- qchisq(1 - pvals, 1)
  round(median(chisq) / qchisq(0.5, 1), 3)
}

qq1 <- qq_data(results_nocorr, "Current vs Never\n(without CT)")
qq2 <- qq_data(results_matched, "Age-matched\n(without CT)")
qq3 <- qq_data(results_cc, "Current vs Never\n(with CT)")
qq4 <- qq_data(results_matched2, "Age-matched\n(with CT)")

l1 <- calc_lambda(results_nocorr)
l2 <- calc_lambda(results_matched)
l3 <- calc_lambda(results_cc)
l4 <- calc_lambda(results_matched2)

cat("\nLambda zonder CT:", l1, "|", l2, "\n")
cat("Lambda met CT:   ", l3, "|", l4, "\n")

qq_plot <- function(df, lambda_val, color) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5, color = color) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = max(df$observed) * 0.9,
             label = paste0("\u03BB = ", lambda_val),
             hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = color) +
    labs(x = expression(-log[10](expected~p)),
         y = expression(-log[10](observed~p)),
         title = df$model[1]) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
}

p1 <- qq_plot(qq1, l1, "firebrick")
p2 <- qq_plot(qq2, l2, "firebrick")
p3 <- qq_plot(qq3, l3, "steelblue")
p4 <- qq_plot(qq4, l4, "steelblue")

p_qq <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "QQ-plots: without (top) vs with (bottom) cell type correction",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  )

print(p_qq)
ggsave("QQ_plots_2x2.pdf", p_qq, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("QQ_plots_2x2.png", p_qq, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
bekende_markers <- c(
  "cg05575921" = "AHRR",
  "cg03636183" = "F2RL3",
  "cg19859270" = "GPR15",
  "cg09935388" = "GFI1",
  "cg12803068" = "MYO1G",
  "cg25648203" = "AHRR",
  "cg14817490" = "AHRR",
  "cg21566642" = "ALPPL2"
)

haal_marker <- function(results_df, cpg_target, label = "") {
  all_cpgs_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_df))
  idx <- which(all_cpgs_clean == cpg_target)
  if (length(idx) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(CpG = cpg_target, Gen = label,
                      logFC = NA, P.Value = NA, adj.P.Val = NA,
                      Status = "Niet aanwezig"))
  }
  row_data <- results_df[idx[1], ]
  data.frame(
    CpG = cpg_target, Gen = label,
    logFC = signif(row_data$logFC, 4),
    P.Value = signif(row_data$P.Value, 3),
    adj.P.Val = signif(row_data$adj.P.Val, 3),
    Status = ifelse(row_data$adj.P.Val < 0.05,
                    "Significant", "Niet significant")
  )
}

if (exists("results_pack")) {
  cat("=== MARKERS IN PACK-YEARS MODEL ===\n\n")
  marker_df_pack <- do.call(rbind, Map(haal_marker,
    list(results_pack), names(bekende_markers), bekende_markers))
  print(marker_df_pack)
  write.csv(marker_df_pack, "bekende_markers_packyears.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

if (exists("results_cur")) {
  cat("\n=== MARKERS IN CURRENT VS NEVER MODEL ===\n\n")
  marker_df_cur <- do.call(rbind, Map(haal_marker,
    list(results_cur), names(bekende_markers), bekende_markers))
  print(marker_df_cur)
}
```

```{r}
bereken_lambda <- function(p_values) {
  chisq <- qchisq(1 - p_values, 1)
  round(median(chisq, na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, 1), 3)
}

qq_plot <- function(p_values, titel) {
  obs <- -log10(sort(p_values))
  exp <- -log10(ppoints(length(obs)))
  lambda <- bereken_lambda(p_values)

  ggplot(data.frame(Expected = exp, Observed = obs),
         aes(Expected, Observed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = titel, subtitle = sprintf("λ = %.3f", lambda),
         x = expression(Expected ~ -log[10](p)),
         y = expression(Observed ~ -log[10](p)))
}

qq1 <- qq_plot(results_pack$P.Value, "Pack-years model")
qq3 <- qq_plot(results_matched$P.Value, "Age-matched Current vs Never")

if (exists("results_cur")) {
  qq2 <- qq_plot(results_cur$P.Value, "Current vs Never (origineel)")
  qq1 + qq2 + qq3
} else {
  qq1 + qq3
}
```

```{r}
    signif(p_hyper, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(EpiDISH)

rownames(meth_clean) <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(meth_clean))

# Referentie voor epitheel/immuun cellen in luchtwegen
data(centEpiFibIC.m)

# Schat celtypes
out <- epidish(beta.m = meth_clean, ref.m = centEpiFibIC.m, method = "RPC")
cell_props <- as.data.frame(out$estF)

print(aggregate(cbind(Epi, Fib, IC) ~ smoking, data = cell_props,
                FUN = function(x) round(mean(x), 3)))

# Nu toevoegen aan DMA model
clinical$Epi <- out$estF[, "Epi"]
clinical$IC  <- out$estF[, "IC"]   # Immune Cells

# Herhaal Current vs Never met celtype-correctie
design_cc <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC,
                          data = clinical)
fit_cc <- lmFit(methylation, design_cc)
fit_cc <- eBayes(fit_cc)

results_cc <- topTable(fit_cc, coef = 3, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_cc <- results_cc[results_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

cat("\nCurrent vs Never met celtype-correctie:", nrow(dmps_cc), "DMPs\n")

# Overlap met originele 323
orig <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cur))
cc   <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc))
cat("Overlap met originele DMPs:", length(intersect(orig, cc)), "\n")
```

```{r}
cpgs_cc      <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc))       # 370
cpgs_matched <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_matched))   # 108
cpgs_cur     <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cur))       # 323

# DMPs die in alle 3 overleven: origineel + age-matched + celtype-gecorrigeerd
final_core <- Reduce(intersect, list(cpgs_cur, cpgs_matched, cpgs_cc))
cat("Finale core set (3 modellen):", length(final_core), "\n")

idx <- match(final_core, rownames(anno))
final_df <- data.frame(
  CpG       = final_core,
  Gene      = gsub(";.*", "", anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx]),
  Chr       = anno$chr[idx],
  Island    = anno$Relation_to_Island[idx],
  logFC     = results_cur$logFC[match(final_core, sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cur)))],
  adj.P     = results_cur$adj.P.Val[match(final_core, sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cur)))],
  Direction = ifelse(
    results_cur$logFC[match(final_core, sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cur)))] < 0,
    "Hypo", "Hyper")
)
final_df <- final_df[order(final_df$adj.P), ]

cat("\nFinale bulletproof DMPs:\n")
print(final_df)
write.csv(final_df, "FINALE_bulletproof_DMPs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
if (length(final_core) > 0) {

  top_cpgs <- head(final_df$CpG, min(20, nrow(final_df)))
  
  plot_data <- data.frame()
  for (cpg in top_cpgs) {
    row_idx <- which(sub("_.*", "", rownames(methylation)) == cpg)
    if (length(row_idx) == 0) next
    
    betas <- methylation[row_idx[1], ]
    plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, data.frame(
      CpG     = cpg,
      Gene    = final_df$Gene[final_df$CpG == cpg],
      Beta    = as.numeric(betas),
      Smoking = clinical$smoking_cat
    ))
  }
  
  plot_data$label <- ifelse(plot_data$Gene == "" | is.na(plot_data$Gene),
                            plot_data$CpG, 
                            paste0(plot_data$Gene, "\n(", plot_data$CpG, ")"))
  
  plot_summary <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(label, Smoking) %>%
    summarise(mean_beta = mean(Beta, na.rm = TRUE),
              se = sd(Beta, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  ggplot(plot_summary, aes(x = Smoking, y = mean_beta, 
                           group = label, color = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_beta - se, ymax = mean_beta + se),
                  width = 0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    scale_color_discrete(guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Never", "Ex", "Current")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = "Reversibiliteitspatroon: bulletproof DMPs",
         subtitle = "Ex-smokers zouden terug moeten keren naar never-smoker niveau",
         x = NULL, y = "Gemiddelde β-waarde")
```

```{r}
# Afstandsanalyse
cpg_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc))
idx <- match(cpg_clean, rownames(anno))

dmp_pos <- data.frame(
  CpG = cpg_clean,
  Chr = anno$chr[idx],
  Pos = anno$pos[idx],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dmp_pos <- dmp_pos[!is.na(dmp_pos$Chr), ]
dmp_pos <- dmp_pos[order(dmp_pos$Chr, dmp_pos$Pos), ]

dmp_pos$dist_to_next <- NA
for (i in 1:(nrow(dmp_pos) - 1)) {
  if (dmp_pos$Chr[i] == dmp_pos$Chr[i + 1]) {
    dmp_pos$dist_to_next[i] <- dmp_pos$Pos[i + 1] - dmp_pos$Pos[i]
  }
}

distances <- dmp_pos$dist_to_next[!is.na(dmp_pos$dist_to_next)]

cat("Afstanden tussen opeenvolgende DMPs:\n")
cat("  Mediaan:", round(median(distances)), "bp\n")
cat("  < 1 kb:", sum(distances < 1000), "paren\n")
cat("  < 5 kb:", sum(distances < 5000), "paren\n")
cat("  < 10 kb:", sum(distances < 10000), "paren\n\n")

set.seed(42)
bg_cpgs <- sample(rownames(anno), length(cpg_clean))
bg_pos <- data.frame(
  Chr = anno$chr[match(bg_cpgs, rownames(anno))],
  Pos = anno$pos[match(bg_cpgs, rownames(anno))]
)
bg_pos <- bg_pos[!is.na(bg_pos$Chr), ]
bg_pos <- bg_pos[order(bg_pos$Chr, bg_pos$Pos), ]

bg_dist <- c()
for (i in 1:(nrow(bg_pos) - 1)) {
  if (bg_pos$Chr[i] == bg_pos$Chr[i + 1]) {
    bg_dist <- c(bg_dist, bg_pos$Pos[i + 1] - bg_pos$Pos[i])
  }
}

cat("Achtergrond mediaan:", round(median(bg_dist)), "bp\n")

w_test <- wilcox.test(distances, bg_dist, alternative = "less")
cat("Wilcoxon p =", signif(w_test$p.value, 3), "\n")

dist_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(Afstand = distances, Groep = "Rook-DMPs"),
  data.frame(Afstand = bg_dist, Groep = "Random CpGs")
)

ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = log10(Afstand), fill = Groep)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rook-DMPs" = "firebrick",
                               "Random CpGs" = "gray60")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log10(1000), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Afstandsverdeling tussen opeenvolgende DMPs",
       subtitle = paste("Wilcoxon p =", signif(w_test$p.value, 3)),
       x = "log10(afstand in bp)", y = "Dichtheid", fill = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Eerst alle contrasten die in je workspace zitten verzamelen
# Sommige moet je misschien opnieuw maken (ex vs cur, binary, ever)

# Current vs Ex (als die niet meer bestaat)
if (!exists("dmps_ex_vs_cur")) {
  clinical_smokers_only <- clinical[clinical$smoking.status != "Non.smoker", ]
  methylation_smokers_only <- methylation[, rownames(clinical_smokers_only)]
  design_evc <- model.matrix(~ smoking.status + gender + age,
                             data = clinical_smokers_only)
  fit_evc <- lmFit(methylation_smokers_only, design_evc)
  fit_evc <- eBayes(fit_evc)
  results_ex_vs_cur <- topTable(fit_evc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  dmps_ex_vs_cur <- results_ex_vs_cur[results_ex_vs_cur$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
}

# Binary (Never+Ex vs Current)
if (!exists("dmps_binary")) {
  clinical$smoking_binary_grouped <- ifelse(
    clinical$smoking.status == "Current.smoker", "Current.smoker", "Never_or_Ex")
  design_bin <- model.matrix(~ smoking_binary_grouped + gender + age, data = clinical)
  fit_bin <- lmFit(methylation, design_bin)
  fit_bin <- eBayes(fit_bin)
  results_binary <- topTable(fit_bin, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  dmps_binary <- results_binary[results_binary$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
}

# Ever vs Never
if (!exists("dmps_ever")) {
  clinical$ever_smoker <- ifelse(clinical$smoking.status == "Non.smoker", "Never", "Ever")
  design_ev <- model.matrix(~ ever_smoker + gender + age, data = clinical)
  fit_ev <- lmFit(methylation, design_ev)
  fit_ev <- eBayes(fit_ev)
  results_ever <- topTable(fit_ev, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  dmps_ever <- results_ever[results_ever$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
}

cat("Contrasten in geheugen:\n")
cat("  Current vs Never:        ", nrow(dmps_cur), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Current vs Never (CT):   ", nrow(dmps_cc), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Age-matched + CT:        ", nrow(dmps_matched2), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Current vs Ex:           ", nrow(dmps_ex_vs_cur), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Binary (Never+Ex vs Cur):", nrow(dmps_binary), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Ever vs Never:           ", nrow(dmps_ever), "DMPs\n")
cat("  Ex vs Never:             ", nrow(dmps_ex), "DMPs\n")
```

```{r}
  for (naam in names(alle_contrasts)) {
    dmps <- alle_contrasts[[naam]]
    cpg_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps))
    idx_anno <- match(cpg_clean, rownames(anno))
    gen_namen <- gsub(";.*", "", anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx_anno])
    
    hits <- which(gen_namen == gen)
    if (length(hits) > 0) {
      n_contrasten <- n_contrasten + 1
      contrasten_lijst <- c(contrasten_lijst, naam)
      richtingen <- c(richtingen,
        ifelse(mean(dmps$logFC[hits]) < 0, "Hypo", "Hyper"))
    }
  }
  
  gen_overzicht <- rbind(gen_overzicht, data.frame(
    Gen = gen,
    n_contrasten = n_contrasten,
    contrasten = paste(contrasten_lijst, collapse = " | "),
    richtingen = paste(richtingen, collapse = " | "),
    in_literatuur = gen %in% literatuur_genen,
    in_core_95 = gen %in% unique(final_df2$Gene[!is.na(final_df2$Gene)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
```

```{r}
# Hypergeometrische test
all_genes_450k <- unique(gsub(";.*", "", anno$UCSC_RefGene_Name))

bekend_op_array <- intersect(literatuur_genen, all_genes_450k)

p_val <- phyper(nrow(gevonden) - 1,
                length(bekend_op_array),
                length(all_genes_450k) - length(bekend_op_array),
                length(alle_genen),
                lower.tail = FALSE)

expected <- length(alle_genen) * length(bekend_op_array) / length(all_genes_450k)
cat("\nHypergeometrische p =", signif(p_val, 3), "\n")
cat("Verwacht:", round(expected, 2), "| Gevonden:", nrow(gevonden),
    "| O/E:", round(nrow(gevonden) / max(expected, 0.001), 1), "×\n")
```

```{r}
# ================================================
# Uitgebreide PCA interpretatie: PC1 tot PC10
# ================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 1. Variantie per PC netjes weergeven
var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:10] * 100
cat("=== Variantie verklaard per PC ===\n")
print(round(var_exp, 2))

# Maak een data.frame voor makkelijke plotting
pca_var_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:10),
  Variance = var_exp[1:10]
)

ggplot(pca_var_df, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Variance, 1)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Percentage variantie per Principal Component",
       y = "Variantie (%)", x = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 2. Uitgebreide associatie heatmap (R²) voor PC1-PC10
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:10])
pca_scores$smoking_cat <- clinical$smoking_cat
pca_scores$gender      <- clinical$gender
pca_scores$age         <- clinical$age
pca_scores$asthma      <- factor(clinical$asthma.status)
pca_scores$pack        <- clinical$PACKNO
pca_scores$chip_id     <- factor(clinical$chip_id)

# Voeg celtype-proporties toe als je EpiDISH al hebt gerund
if (exists("cell_props")) {
  pca_scores$Epi <- cell_props$Epi
  pca_scores$IC  <- cell_props$IC
}

assoc_df <- data.frame()
for (pc in paste0("PC", 1:10)) {
  r2_smok <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ smoking_cat, data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_gend <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ gender,      data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_age  <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ age,         data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_asth <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ asthma,      data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_pack <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ pack,        data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  r2_chip <- summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ chip_id,     data = pca_scores))$r.squared
  
  r2_epi <- if ("Epi" %in% colnames(pca_scores)) 
              summary(lm(pca_scores[[pc]] ~ Epi, data = pca_scores))$r.squared else NA
  
  assoc_df <- rbind(assoc_df, data.frame(
    PC = pc,
    Smoking     = r2_smok,
    Gender      = r2_gend,
    Age         = r2_age,
    Asthma      = r2_asth,
    PackYears   = r2_pack,
    Chip        = r2_chip,
    Epitheel    = r2_epi
  ))
}

# Heatmap
assoc_long <- assoc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-PC, names_to = "Variabele", values_to = "R2")

ggplot(assoc_long, aes(x = PC, y = Variabele, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", R2)),
            color = ifelse(assoc_long$R2 > 0.4, "white", "black"), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b", limits = c(0, 1), name = "R²") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Associatie tussen Principal Components en klinische variabelen",
       subtitle = "Hoe hoger de R², hoe sterker het verband met die PC",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Alle contrasten opnieuw draaien MET correcte covariaten

# 1. Current vs Never (al correct, maar voor zekerheid)
design_cat <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age, data = clinical)
fit_cat <- lmFit(methylation, design_cat)
fit_cat <- eBayes(fit_cat)
results_cur <- topTable(fit_cat, coef = 3, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
results_ex  <- topTable(fit_cat, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_cur <- results_cur[results_cur$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
dmps_ex  <- results_ex[results_ex$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

# 2. Current vs Ex
clinical_smokers_only <- clinical[clinical$smoking.status != "Non.smoker", ]
meth_smokers <- methylation[, rownames(clinical_smokers_only)]
design_evc <- model.matrix(~ smoking.status + gender + age, data = clinical_smokers_only)
fit_evc <- lmFit(meth_smokers, design_evc)
fit_evc <- eBayes(fit_evc)
results_ex_vs_cur <- topTable(fit_evc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_ex_vs_cur <- results_ex_vs_cur[results_ex_vs_cur$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

# 3. Binary (Never+Ex vs Current)
clinical$smoking_binary <- factor(
  ifelse(clinical$smoking.status == "Current.smoker", "Current", "Never_or_Ex"),
  levels = c("Never_or_Ex", "Current"))
design_bin <- model.matrix(~ smoking_binary + gender + age, data = clinical)
fit_bin <- lmFit(methylation, design_bin)
fit_bin <- eBayes(fit_bin)
results_binary <- topTable(fit_bin, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_binary <- results_binary[results_binary$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

# 4. Ever vs Never
clinical$ever_smoker <- factor(
  ifelse(clinical$smoking.status == "Non.smoker", "Never", "Ever"),
  levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
design_ev <- model.matrix(~ ever_smoker + gender + age, data = clinical)
fit_ev <- lmFit(methylation, design_ev)
fit_ev <- eBayes(fit_ev)
results_ever <- topTable(fit_ev, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_ever <- results_ever[results_ever$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

# Overzicht
cat("=== ALLE CONTRASTEN (met gender + age correctie) ===\n")
cat("Current vs Never:          ", nrow(dmps_cur), "DMPs\n")
cat("Ex vs Never:               ", nrow(dmps_ex), "DMPs\n")
cat("Current vs Ex:             ", nrow(dmps_ex_vs_cur), "DMPs\n")
cat("Binary (Never+Ex vs Cur):  ", nrow(dmps_binary), "DMPs\n")
cat("Ever vs Never:             ", nrow(dmps_ever), "DMPs\n")

# Design kolommen checken
cat("\n=== DESIGN CHECKS ===\n")
cat("3-weg:      ", colnames(design_cat), "\n")
cat("Current/Ex: ", colnames(design_evc), "\n")
cat("Binary:     ", colnames(design_bin), "\n")
cat("Ever/Never: ", colnames(design_ev), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Herbereken literatuurvalidatie met EPIC genen
gevonden_epic <- intersect(gene_epic_unique, literatuur_genen)
cat("Literatuurgenen gevonden met EPIC annotatie:", length(gevonden_epic), "\n")
cat("Was met 450K:", 8, "\n")
print(gevonden_epic)

# Hypergeometrische test
all_genes_epic <- unique(gsub(";.*", "", anno_epic$UCSC_RefGene_Name))
all_genes_epic <- all_genes_epic[all_genes_epic != ""]
bekend_op_epic <- intersect(literatuur_genen, all_genes_epic)

p_val_epic <- phyper(length(gevonden_epic) - 1,
                     length(bekend_op_epic),
                     length(all_genes_epic) - length(bekend_op_epic),
                     length(gene_epic_unique),
                     lower.tail = FALSE)
expected_epic <- length(gene_epic_unique) * length(bekend_op_epic) / length(all_genes_epic)
cat("\nHypergeometrische p =", signif(p_val_epic, 3), "\n")
cat("Verwacht:", round(expected_epic, 2), "| Gevonden:", length(gevonden_epic),
    "| O/E:", round(length(gevonden_epic) / max(expected_epic, 0.001), 1), "×\n")
```

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLLEDIGE ASTMA CONFOUND-CHECK (alle ontbrekende stappen)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ─── 1. Lambda check op het originele astma-model ───
cat("=== 1. LAMBDA CHECK ASTMA-MODEL (ORIGINEEL) ===\n")
cat("Lambda astma-model (never-smokers):", 
    bereken_lambda(results_asthma_never$P.Value), "\n")
cat("DMPs zonder celtype-correctie:", nrow(dmps_asthma_never), "\n\n")

# ─── 2. Astma-model MET celtype-correctie ───
cat("=== 2. ASTMA-MODEL MET CELTYPE-CORRECTIE ===\n")
samples_never <- rownames(clinical)[clinical$smoking_cat == "Non.smoker"]
clin_never <- clinical[samples_never, ]
meth_never <- methylation[, samples_never]

clin_never$asthma.status <- factor(clin_never$asthma.status)

design_astma_cc <- model.matrix(~ asthma.status + gender + age + Epi + IC, 
                                 data = clin_never)
cat("Design kolommen:", colnames(design_astma_cc), "\n")

fit_astma_cc <- lmFit(meth_never, design_astma_cc)
fit_astma_cc <- eBayes(fit_astma_cc)

results_astma_cc <- topTable(fit_astma_cc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_astma_cc <- results_astma_cc[results_astma_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

lambda_astma_orig <- bereken_lambda(results_asthma_never$P.Value)
lambda_astma_cc <- bereken_lambda(results_astma_cc$P.Value)

cat("Lambda ZONDER celtype-correctie:", lambda_astma_orig, "\n")
cat("Lambda MET celtype-correctie:   ", lambda_astma_cc, "\n")
cat("DMPs ZONDER celtype-correctie:  ", nrow(dmps_asthma_never), "\n")
cat("DMPs MET celtype-correctie:     ", nrow(dmps_astma_cc), "\n\n")

# ─── 3. QQ-plots astma (voor vs na correctie) ───
cat("=== 3. QQ-PLOTS ===\n")
qq_astma1 <- qq_plot(results_asthma_never$P.Value, "Astma (zonder celtype-correctie)")
qq_astma2 <- qq_plot(results_astma_cc$P.Value, "Astma (met celtype-correctie)")
print(qq_astma1 + qq_astma2)

# ─── 4. Overlap rook × astma HERBEREKEND met gecorrigeerde astma-DMPs ───
cat("\n=== 4. OVERLAP ROOK x ASTMA (GEÜPDATET) ===\n")
rook_cpgs <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_matched))  # 108 age-matched rook-DMPs

# Overlap met ORIGINELE astma-DMPs
astma_cpgs_orig <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_asthma_never))
overlap_orig <- intersect(rook_cpgs, astma_cpgs_orig)

# Overlap met CELTYPE-GECORRIGEERDE astma-DMPs
astma_cpgs_cc <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_astma_cc))
overlap_cc <- intersect(rook_cpgs, astma_cpgs_cc)

cat("Rook-DMPs (age-matched):           ", length(rook_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Astma-DMPs ZONDER CT:              ", length(astma_cpgs_orig), "\n")
cat("Astma-DMPs MET CT:                 ", length(astma_cpgs_cc), "\n")
cat("Overlap rook x astma (zonder CT):  ", length(overlap_orig), 
    "(", round(length(overlap_orig)/length(rook_cpgs)*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Overlap rook x astma (met CT):     ", length(overlap_cc),
    "(", round(length(overlap_cc)/length(rook_cpgs)*100, 1), "%)\n\n")

# Hypergeometrische test op gecorrigeerde overlap
N <- nrow(methylation)
p_overlap_cc <- phyper(length(overlap_cc) - 1, length(astma_cpgs_cc),
                        N - length(astma_cpgs_cc), length(rook_cpgs),
                        lower.tail = FALSE)
expected_cc <- length(rook_cpgs) * length(astma_cpgs_cc) / N
cat("Hypergeometrische test (met CT):\n")
cat("  p =", signif(p_overlap_cc, 3), "\n")
cat("  Verwacht:", round(expected_cc, 2), "| Gevonden:", length(overlap_cc), "\n\n")

# ─── 5. Rook-contrasten MET astma + celtype-correctie ───
cat("=== 5. ROOKCONTRASTEN MET ASTMA + CELTYPE-CORRECTIE ===\n")

# Current vs Never met astma + celtype
design_rook_astma_cc <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC + asthma.status, 
                                      data = clinical)
fit_rook_astma_cc <- lmFit(methylation, design_rook_astma_cc)
fit_rook_astma_cc <- eBayes(fit_rook_astma_cc)

results_cur_astma_cc <- topTable(fit_rook_astma_cc, coef = 3, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
dmps_cur_astma_cc <- results_cur_astma_cc[results_cur_astma_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]

lambda_cur_astma_cc <- bereken_lambda(results_cur_astma_cc$P.Value)

cat("Current vs Never (celtype-gecorrigeerd, ZONDER astma):", nrow(dmps_cc), "DMPs, lambda:", 
    bereken_lambda(results_cc$P.Value), "\n")
cat("Current vs Never (celtype-gecorrigeerd, MET astma):   ", nrow(dmps_cur_astma_cc), "DMPs, lambda:", 
    lambda_cur_astma_cc, "\n")

# Overlap
cpgs_cc_only <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc))
cpgs_cc_astma <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cur_astma_cc))
overlap_rook <- intersect(cpgs_cc_only, cpgs_cc_astma)
cat("Overlap:", length(overlap_rook), "van", length(cpgs_cc_only), 
    "(", round(length(overlap_rook)/length(cpgs_cc_only)*100, 1), "%)\n\n")

# ─── 6. AHRR check in het astma-gecorrigeerde model ───
cat("=== 6. AHRR IN ASTMA-GECORRIGEERD MODEL ===\n")
print(haal_marker(results_cur_astma_cc, "cg05575921", "AHRR"))

# ─── 7. SAMENVATTING ───
cat("\n=== SAMENVATTING ASTMA-CHECK ===\n")
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8s %8s\n", "Maat", "Zonder CT", "Met CT"))
cat(rep("-", 63), "\n", sep="")
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8d %8d\n", "Astma-DMPs (never-smokers)", nrow(dmps_asthma_never), nrow(dmps_astma_cc)))
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8.3f %8.3f\n", "Lambda astma-model", lambda_astma_orig, lambda_astma_cc))
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8d %8d\n", "Overlap rook x astma", length(overlap_orig), length(overlap_cc)))
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8s %8s\n", "Current vs Never DMPs", 
    paste0(nrow(dmps_cc), " (CT)"), paste0(nrow(dmps_cur_astma_cc), " (CT+A)")))
cat(sprintf("%-45s %8.1f%%\n", "Overlap Current vs Never na astma-correctie", 
    length(overlap_rook)/length(cpgs_cc_only)*100))
```

```{r}
################################################################################
# AANVULLENDE ANALYSES — ERIBA Methylatie Project
# Rook-gerelateerde DNA methylatie in nasaal epitheel
#
# Dit script bevat code voor aanvullende analyses bovenop de bestaande pipeline.
# Vereisten: je hebt de objecten uit je originele analyse nodig:
#   - methylation    : beta-waarde matrix (882234 CpGs x 316 samples)
#   - clinical       : data.frame met smoking_cat, gender, age, PACKNO,
#                       asthma.status, Epi, IC, meth_file_id
#   - results_cc     : topTable output van celtype-gecorrigeerd model
#   - dmps_cc        : significante DMPs (adj.P < 0.05) uit CT-model (370)
#   - results_matched2 : topTable output van age-matched + CT model
#   - dmps_matched2  : significante DMPs uit age-matched + CT model (114)
#   - core_cpgs      : vector met 95 core DMP namen (intersectie)
#
# Als je core_cpgs nog niet hebt, maak die dan eerst:
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 1. PATHWAY-ANALYSE MET missMethyl (gometh)
# =============================================================================
# missMethyl corrigeert voor de probe-bias op de EPIC array:
# genen met meer probes hebben meer kans om significant te zijn.
# gometh() houdt hier rekening mee.

cat("\n========== 1. PATHWAY-ANALYSE (missMethyl) ==========\n\n")

# Gebruik de 370 DMPs uit het celtype-gecorrigeerde model
sig_cpgs <- rownames(dmps_cc)

# Strip eventuele EPICv2 suffixen als die er nog op zitten
sig_cpgs_clean <- sub("_.*", "", sig_cpgs)
all_cpgs_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(methylation))

# --- Gene Ontology ---
go_results <- gometh(
  sig.cpg   = sig_cpgs_clean,
  all.cpg   = all_cpgs_clean,
  collection = "GO",
  array.type = "EPIC",
  plot.bias  = TRUE,  # toont de bias-correctie plot
  prior.prob = TRUE
)

# Filter significante GO-termen
go_sig <- go_results[go_results$FDR < 0.05, ]
go_sig <- go_sig[order(go_sig$FDR), ]

cat("Significante GO-termen (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(go_sig), "\n")
if (nrow(go_sig) > 0) {
  cat("\nTop 20 GO-termen:\n")
  print(head(go_sig[, c("ONTOLOGY", "TERM", "N", "DE", "P.DE", "FDR")], 20))
}

# --- KEGG pathways ---
kegg_results <- gometh(
  sig.cpg    = sig_cpgs_clean,
  all.cpg    = all_cpgs_clean,
  collection = "KEGG",
  array.type = "EPIC",
  prior.prob = TRUE
)

kegg_sig <- kegg_results[kegg_results$FDR < 0.05, ]
kegg_sig <- kegg_sig[order(kegg_sig$FDR), ]

cat("\nSignificante KEGG pathways (FDR < 0.05):", nrow(kegg_sig), "\n")
if (nrow(kegg_sig) > 0) {
  cat("\nTop 20 KEGG pathways:\n")
  print(head(kegg_sig[, c("Description", "N", "DE", "P.DE", "FDR")], 20))
}

# Visualisatie: top-20 GO-termen barplot
if (nrow(go_sig) > 0) {
  top_go <- head(go_sig, 20)
  top_go$TERM <- factor(top_go$TERM, levels = rev(top_go$TERM))

  p_go <- ggplot(top_go, aes(x = -log10(FDR), y = TERM, fill = ONTOLOGY)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Gene Ontology termen (rook-DMPs)",
         x = "-log10(FDR)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

  print(p_go)
  ggsave("pathway_GO_top20.pdf", p_go, width = 10, height = 8)
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. EPIGENETISCHE KLOKKEN
# =============================================================================
# Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge en GrimAge berekenen met de methylclock
# of handmatige implementatie.
#
# Optie A: via het 'methylclock' pakket (als beschikbaar)
# Optie B: handmatig met Horvath coefficienten

cat("\n========== 2. EPIGENETISCHE KLOKKEN ==========\n\n")

# --- Optie A: methylclock pakket ---
if (!requireNamespace("methylclock", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("methylclock niet gevonden. Probeer te installeren...\n")
  tryCatch({
    BiocManager::install("methylclock", ask = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("methylclock kon niet worden geïnstalleerd.\n")
    cat("Gebruik alternatief: Horvath online calculator of dnaMethyAge pakket.\n")
  })
}

if (requireNamespace("methylclock", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(methylclock)

  # Prep: methylclock verwacht een data.frame met CpGs als kolommen
  meth_for_clock <- as.data.frame(t(methylation))
  colnames(meth_for_clock) <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(meth_for_clock))

  # Bereken klokken
  clock_results <- tryCatch({
    DNAmAge(meth_for_clock, normalize = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Fout bij methylclock:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(clock_results)) {
    # Voeg toe aan clinical
    clinical$Horvath_age  <- clock_results$Horvath
    clinical$Hannum_age   <- clock_results$Hannum
    clinical$PhenoAge     <- clock_results$Levine  # PhenoAge = Levine klok
    clinical$age_accel_horvath <- clinical$Horvath_age - clinical$age
    clinical$age_accel_hannum <- clinical$Hannum_age - clinical$age

    # Test verschil in epigenetische veroudering per rookgroep
    cat("Horvath leeftijdsversnelling per rookgroep:\n")
    print(clinical %>%
      group_by(smoking_cat) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        mean_accel = round(mean(age_accel_horvath, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        sd_accel   = round(sd(age_accel_horvath, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      ))

    # Kruskal-Wallis test
    kw_horvath <- kruskal.test(age_accel_horvath ~ smoking_cat, data = clinical)
    cat("\nKruskal-Wallis leeftijdsversnelling ~ rookstatus: p =",
        format.pval(kw_horvath$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")

    # Visualisatie
    p_clock <- ggplot(clinical, aes(x = smoking_cat, y = age_accel_horvath,
                                     fill = smoking_cat)) +
      geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non.smoker" = "steelblue",
                                   "Ex.smoker" = "orange",
                                   "Current.smoker" = "firebrick")) +
      labs(title = "Epigenetische leeftijdsversnelling (Horvath)",
           x = NULL, y = "Leeftijdsversnelling (jaren)") +
      theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")

    print(p_clock)
    ggsave("epigenetic_clock_horvath.pdf", p_clock, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
} else {
  cat("ALTERNATIEF: Gebruik de Horvath online calculator:\n")
  cat("  https://dnamage.genetics.ucla.edu/new\n")
  cat("  Upload een CSV met CpG-waarden (rijen = samples, kolommen = CpGs)\n\n")

  # Exporteer data voor de online calculator
  meth_export <- as.data.frame(t(methylation))
  colnames(meth_export) <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(meth_export))
  meth_export <- cbind(SampleID = rownames(meth_export), meth_export)

  # NB: Dit bestand kan erg groot zijn (~300MB)
  # write.csv(meth_export, "methylation_for_clock.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  Uncomment de write.csv regel hierboven om het exportbestand te maken.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. POWER-ANALYSE
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 3. POWER-ANALYSE ==========\n\n")

# Handmatige power-schatting
cat("--- Handmatige power-schatting ---\n")
cat("Bij n=11 vs n=231:\n\n")

min_sig_logfc <- min(abs(dmps_cc$logFC))
median_sig_logfc <- median(abs(dmps_cc$logFC))

cat("Kleinste significante |logFC|:", round(min_sig_logfc, 4), "\n")
cat("Mediaan significante |logFC|:", round(median_sig_logfc, 4), "\n")

n1 <- 11; n2 <- 231

# Schat SD via SE uit topTable: SE = |logFC / t|
# SE = SD * sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2), dus SD = SE / sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2)
se_vals <- abs(results_cc$logFC / results_cc$t)
se_vals <- se_vals[is.finite(se_vals) & se_vals > 0]
se_factor <- sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2)
pooled_sd <- median(se_vals / se_factor)

# Als fit_cc nog bestaat, gebruik s2.post voor betere schatting
if (exists("fit_cc") && !is.null(fit_cc$s2.post)) {
  pooled_sd <- median(sqrt(fit_cc$s2.post))
  cat("Gepoolde SD (eBayes s2.post):", round(pooled_sd, 4), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Gepoolde SD (geschat uit SE):", round(pooled_sd, 4), "\n")
}

d <- min_sig_logfc / pooled_sd
cat("Geschatte Cohen's d (minimaal):", round(d, 3), "\n")

# Power bij verschillende delta-beta waarden
cat("\nPower bij verschillende delta-beta waarden (Bonferroni-drempel):\n")
deltas <- c(0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20)
for (delta in deltas) {
  p <- power.t.test(n = n1, delta = delta,
                    sd = pooled_sd, sig.level = 0.05 / nrow(methylation),
                    type = "two.sample", alternative = "two.sided")
  cat(sprintf("  delta-beta = %.2f : power = %.3f\n", delta, p$power))
}

# Hoeveel samples nodig voor 80% power?
n_needed <- tryCatch({
  pwr80 <- power.t.test(power = 0.80, delta = median_sig_logfc,
                        sd = pooled_sd, sig.level = 0.05 / nrow(methylation),
                        type = "two.sample", alternative = "two.sided")
  ceiling(pwr80$n)
}, error = function(e) NA)

if (!is.na(n_needed)) {
  cat("\nBenodigd n per groep voor 80% power bij mediaan |logFC| (",
      round(median_sig_logfc, 3), "):", n_needed, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 4. FORMELE REVERSIBILITEITSTEST
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 4. FORMELE REVERSIBILITEITSTEST ==========\n\n")

results_ex_cc <- topTable(fit_cc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

# --- Robuuste matching: probeer directe match, anders strip suffixen ---
match_cpg <- function(cpg_names, result_table) {
  # Probeer directe match
  direct <- result_table[cpg_names, "logFC"]
  names(direct) <- cpg_names
  
  # Voor NAs: probeer te matchen na strippen van suffixen
  na_idx <- which(is.na(direct))
  if (length(na_idx) > 0) {
    clean_cpgs <- sub("_.*", "", cpg_names[na_idx])
    clean_rows <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(result_table))
    for (i in seq_along(na_idx)) {
      hit <- which(clean_rows == clean_cpgs[i])
      if (length(hit) > 0) {
        direct[na_idx[i]] <- result_table$logFC[hit[1]]
      }
    }
  }
  return(direct)
}

logfc_current <- match_cpg(core_cpgs, results_cc)
logfc_ex      <- match_cpg(core_cpgs, results_ex_cc)

# Hetzelfde voor adj.P.Val
match_col <- function(cpg_names, result_table, col) {
  direct <- result_table[cpg_names, col]
  names(direct) <- cpg_names
  na_idx <- which(is.na(direct))
  if (length(na_idx) > 0) {
    clean_cpgs <- sub("_.*", "", cpg_names[na_idx])
    clean_rows <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(result_table))
    for (i in seq_along(na_idx)) {
      hit <- which(clean_rows == clean_cpgs[i])
      if (length(hit) > 0) {
        direct[na_idx[i]] <- result_table[[col]][hit[1]]
      }
    }
  }
  return(direct)
}

core_effects <- data.frame(
  CpG          = core_cpgs,
  logFC_current = logfc_current,
  logFC_ex      = logfc_ex,
  adjP_current  = match_col(core_cpgs, results_cc, "adj.P.Val"),
  adjP_ex       = match_col(core_cpgs, results_ex_cc, "adj.P.Val")
)

# Check hoeveel NAs er nog zijn
cat("Matched CpGs:", sum(!is.na(core_effects$logFC_current) & 
                         !is.na(core_effects$logFC_ex)), "van", nrow(core_effects), "\n\n")

# Recovery percentage per CpG
core_effects$abs_current <- abs(core_effects$logFC_current)
core_effects$abs_ex      <- abs(core_effects$logFC_ex)
core_effects$recovery_pct <- (1 - core_effects$abs_ex / core_effects$abs_current) * 100
core_effects$recovery_pct[core_effects$recovery_pct < 0] <- 0
core_effects$recovery_pct[core_effects$recovery_pct > 100] <- 100

# Gepaarde Wilcoxon test (na.rm via complete cases)
complete <- complete.cases(core_effects$abs_current, core_effects$abs_ex)
wil_rev <- wilcox.test(core_effects$abs_current[complete], 
                       core_effects$abs_ex[complete],
                       paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")

cat("Gepaarde Wilcoxon test op effectgroottes:\n")
cat("  H0: |logFC(Current vs Never)| = |logFC(Ex vs Never)|\n")
cat("  H1: |logFC(Current vs Never)| > |logFC(Ex vs Never)|\n")
cat("  V =", wil_rev$statistic, "\n")
cat("  p =", format.pval(wil_rev$p.value, digits = 4), "\n\n")

# Samenvatting recovery
cat("Recovery percentage (core DMPs):\n")
cat("  Gemiddeld:", round(mean(core_effects$recovery_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Mediaan:", round(median(core_effects$recovery_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(core_effects$recovery_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Max:", round(max(core_effects$recovery_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("  CpGs met >75% recovery:", sum(core_effects$recovery_pct > 75, na.rm = TRUE),
    "van", sum(!is.na(core_effects$recovery_pct)), "\n")
cat("  CpGs met >90% recovery:", sum(core_effects$recovery_pct > 90, na.rm = TRUE),
    "van", sum(!is.na(core_effects$recovery_pct)), "\n\n")

# Visualisatie 1: effectgrootte scatter
p_rev1 <- ggplot(core_effects[complete, ], aes(x = logFC_current, y = logFC_ex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_abline(slope = 0, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Effectgrootte: Current vs Ex (core DMPs)",
       subtitle = paste("Gepaarde Wilcoxon p =",
                        format.pval(wil_rev$p.value, digits = 3)),
       x = "logFC (Current vs Never)",
       y = "logFC (Ex vs Never)") +
  theme_minimal() + coord_fixed()
print(p_rev1)
ggsave("reversibility_effectsize_scatter.pdf", p_rev1, width = 7, height = 7)

# Visualisatie 2: recovery histogram
core_complete <- core_effects[!is.na(core_effects$recovery_pct), ]
p_rev2 <- ggplot(core_complete, aes(x = recovery_pct)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(core_complete$recovery_pct),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Recovery percentage per core DMP",
       subtitle = paste("Mediaan:", round(median(core_complete$recovery_pct), 1), "%"),
       x = "Recovery (%)", y = "Aantal CpGs") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_rev2)
ggsave("reversibility_recovery_histogram.pdf", p_rev2, width = 8, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5. FORMELE MEDIATIE-ANALYSE (celtype als mediator)
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 5. MEDIATIE-ANALYSE ==========\n\n")

library(mediation)

# Maak binary rookvariabele (Current=1, Never=0) voor mediatie
clin_cn <- clinical[clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Non.smoker", "Current.smoker"), ]
clin_cn$is_current <- as.numeric(clin_cn$smoking_cat == "Current.smoker")
meth_cn <- methylation[, rownames(clin_cn)]

# Helper: vind de juiste rijnaam in de methylation matrix
find_row <- function(cpg, mat) {
  if (cpg %in% rownames(mat)) return(cpg)
  # Probeer te matchen na strippen van suffixen
  clean <- sub("_.*", "", cpg)
  hits <- which(sub("_.*", "", rownames(mat)) == clean)
  if (length(hits) > 0) return(rownames(mat)[hits[1]])
  return(NA)
}

# Top 5 core DMPs (meest significant, zonder NAs)
core_sorted <- core_effects[order(core_effects$adjP_current), ]
core_sorted <- core_sorted[!is.na(core_sorted$adjP_current), ]
top5_core <- head(core_sorted$CpG, 5)

cat("Mediatie-analyse voor top-5 core DMPs:\n")
cat("Mediator: epitheel-celtype proportie (Epi)\n")
cat("Treatment: rookstatus (Current vs Never)\n\n")

mediation_results <- list()

for (cpg in top5_core) {
  # Vind de juiste rijnaam in de methylation matrix
  row_name <- find_row(cpg, meth_cn)
  
  if (is.na(row_name)) {
    cat("  ", cpg, ": niet gevonden in methylation matrix, overgeslagen\n\n")
    next
  }

  # Stap 1: Mediator model (Epi ~ roken + covariaten)
  med_model <- lm(Epi ~ is_current + gender + age, data = clin_cn)

  # Stap 2: Outcome model (methylatie ~ roken + mediator + covariaten)
  clin_cn$y <- as.numeric(meth_cn[row_name, ])
  out_model <- lm(y ~ is_current + Epi + gender + age, data = clin_cn)

  # Stap 3: Mediatie-analyse
  med_result <- tryCatch({
    mediate(med_model, out_model,
            treat = "is_current", mediator = "Epi",
            boot = TRUE, sims = 1000)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  Fout bij", cpg, ":", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(med_result)) {
    mediation_results[[cpg]] <- med_result

    cat(cpg, ":\n")
    cat("  ACME (indirect/mediatie effect):", round(med_result$d0, 5),
        " p =", format.pval(med_result$d0.p, digits = 3), "\n")
    cat("  ADE (direct effect):", round(med_result$z0, 5),
        " p =", format.pval(med_result$z0.p, digits = 3), "\n")
    cat("  Totaal effect:", round(med_result$tau.coef, 5),
        " p =", format.pval(med_result$tau.p, digits = 3), "\n")
    cat("  Proportie gemedieerd:", round(med_result$n0, 3), "\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. REGIONALE VERRIJKINGSANALYSE (ChromHMM / Enhancers)
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 6. REGIONALE VERRIJKINGSANALYSE ==========\n\n")

# Gebruik EPIC annotatie om te testen of DMPs verrijkt zijn in
# specifieke regulatoire elementen

library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
ann <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)

# Match DMPs met annotatie
sig_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc))
all_clean <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(methylation))

# Subset annotatie
ann_sig <- ann[ann$Name %in% sig_clean, ]
ann_all <- ann[ann$Name %in% all_clean, ]

# --- Enhancer verrijking ---
if ("Enhancer" %in% colnames(ann)) {
  n_enh_sig <- sum(ann_sig$Enhancer == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_enh_all <- sum(ann_all$Enhancer == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_sig <- nrow(ann_sig)
  n_all <- nrow(ann_all)

  fisher_enh <- fisher.test(matrix(c(
    n_enh_sig, n_sig - n_enh_sig,
    n_enh_all - n_enh_sig, (n_all - n_sig) - (n_enh_all - n_enh_sig)
  ), nrow = 2))

  cat("Enhancer verrijking:\n")
  cat("  DMPs in enhancers:", n_enh_sig, "/", n_sig,
      "(", round(100 * n_enh_sig / n_sig, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  Achtergrond:", n_enh_all, "/", n_all,
      "(", round(100 * n_enh_all / n_all, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  OR =", round(fisher_enh$estimate, 2),
      " p =", format.pval(fisher_enh$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")
}

# --- DHS (DNase Hypersensitivity Sites) verrijking ---
if ("DHS" %in% colnames(ann)) {
  n_dhs_sig <- sum(ann_sig$DHS == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_dhs_all <- sum(ann_all$DHS == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE)

  fisher_dhs <- fisher.test(matrix(c(
    n_dhs_sig, n_sig - n_dhs_sig,
    n_dhs_all - n_dhs_sig, (n_all - n_sig) - (n_dhs_all - n_dhs_sig)
  ), nrow = 2))

  cat("DHS verrijking:\n")
  cat("  DMPs in DHS:", n_dhs_sig, "/", n_sig,
      "(", round(100 * n_dhs_sig / n_sig, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  OR =", round(fisher_dhs$estimate, 2),
      " p =", format.pval(fisher_dhs$p.value, digits = 3), "\n\n")
}

# --- Gedetailleerde Relation_to_Island verdeling ---
cat("CpG-eiland relatie verdeling (DMPs vs achtergrond):\n\n")
island_sig <- table(ann_sig$Relation_to_Island)
island_all <- table(ann_all$Relation_to_Island)

island_df <- data.frame(
  Context    = names(island_all),
  N_sig      = as.numeric(island_sig[names(island_all)]),
  Pct_sig    = round(100 * as.numeric(island_sig[names(island_all)]) / sum(island_sig), 1),
  N_bg       = as.numeric(island_all),
  Pct_bg     = round(100 * as.numeric(island_all) / sum(island_all), 1)
)
island_df$N_sig[is.na(island_df$N_sig)] <- 0
island_df$Pct_sig[is.na(island_df$Pct_sig)] <- 0

# Fisher's exact per categorie
island_df$p_value <- sapply(island_df$Context, function(ctx) {
  in_sig <- sum(ann_sig$Relation_to_Island == ctx, na.rm = TRUE)
  not_in_sig <- nrow(ann_sig) - in_sig
  in_bg <- sum(ann_all$Relation_to_Island == ctx, na.rm = TRUE) - in_sig
  not_in_bg <- (nrow(ann_all) - nrow(ann_sig)) - in_bg
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(in_sig, not_in_sig, in_bg, not_in_bg), nrow = 2))
  ft$p.value
})

print(island_df)

# --- UCSC_RefGene_Group verdeling ---
cat("\nUCSC RefGene Group verdeling:\n\n")

# Parse de gene groups (kan meerdere per CpG zijn, gescheiden door ;)
parse_groups <- function(x) {
  groups <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(x), ";"))
  groups[groups != ""]
}

sig_groups <- table(unlist(lapply(ann_sig$UCSC_RefGene_Group, parse_groups)))
all_groups <- table(unlist(lapply(ann_all$UCSC_RefGene_Group, parse_groups)))

group_names <- intersect(names(sig_groups), names(all_groups))
group_df <- data.frame(
  Group   = group_names,
  N_sig   = as.numeric(sig_groups[group_names]),
  N_bg    = as.numeric(all_groups[group_names])
)
group_df$Pct_sig <- round(100 * group_df$N_sig / sum(group_df$N_sig), 1)
group_df$Pct_bg  <- round(100 * group_df$N_bg / sum(group_df$N_bg), 1)
group_df$OR      <- round((group_df$N_sig / sum(group_df$N_sig)) /
                          (group_df$N_bg / sum(group_df$N_bg)), 2)
print(group_df)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 8. VOLCANO PLOT (CELTYPE-GECORRIGEERD MODEL)
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 8. VOLCANO PLOT ==========\n\n")

# Maak een volcano plot van het celtype-gecorrigeerde model
volcano_df <- data.frame(
  logFC    = results_cc$logFC,
  neglogP  = -log10(results_cc$P.Value),
  adjP     = results_cc$adj.P.Val,
  CpG      = sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cc))
)

# Annoteer bekende genen voor labeling
volcano_df$gene <- ann[match(volcano_df$CpG, ann$Name), "UCSC_RefGene_Name"]
volcano_df$significant <- ifelse(volcano_df$adjP < 0.05, "Significant", "Niet significant")

# Label top genen
genes_to_label <- c("AHRR", "CYP1B1", "ALDH3A1", "LIMS2", "MLH1",
                    "STAT3", "TP53BP2", "SMAD1")
volcano_df$label <- ifelse(
  grepl(paste(genes_to_label, collapse = "|"), volcano_df$gene) &
  volcano_df$adjP < 0.05,
  volcano_df$gene, ""
)
# Neem alleen eerste gen bij meerdere annotaties
volcano_df$label <- sapply(strsplit(volcano_df$label, ";"), `[`, 1)
volcano_df$label[is.na(volcano_df$label)] <- ""

# Deduplicate labels (alleen meest significante per gen)
for (g in unique(volcano_df$label[volcano_df$label != ""])) {
  idx <- which(volcano_df$label == g)
  if (length(idx) > 1) {
    keep <- idx[which.max(volcano_df$neglogP[idx])]
    volcano_df$label[setdiff(idx, keep)] <- ""
  }
}

library(ggrepel)

p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neglogP, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "firebrick",
                                "Niet significant" = "grey60")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / nrow(results_cc)),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20,
                  color = "black", fontface = "italic") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot — Current vs Never (celtype-gecorrigeerd)",
       x = "logFC (∆β)", y = "-log10(p-waarde)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())

print(p_volcano)
ggsave("volcano_plot_CT_corrected.pdf", p_volcano, width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
cat("\n========== 9. HEATMAP CORE DMPs ==========\n\n")

  result <- character(length(cpg_names))
  for (i in seq_along(cpg_names)) {

      result[i] <- cpg_names[i]

      clean <- sub("_.*", "", cpg_names[i])
      hit <- which(sub("_.*", "", rownames(mat)) == clean)

}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 9. HEATMAP VAN CORE DMPs — GEORDEND OP GROEP EN GESLACHT
# =============================================================================

cat("\n========== 9. HEATMAP CORE DMPs ==========\n\n")

library(pheatmap)

# Vind de juiste rijnamen in de methylation matrix
find_rows <- function(cpg_names, mat) {
  result <- character(length(cpg_names))
  for (i in seq_along(cpg_names)) {
    if (cpg_names[i] %in% rownames(mat)) {
      result[i] <- cpg_names[i]
    } else {
      clean <- sub("_.*", "", cpg_names[i])
      hit <- which(sub("_.*", "", rownames(mat)) == clean)
      result[i] <- if (length(hit) > 0) rownames(mat)[hit[1]] else NA
    }
  }
  return(result)
}

core_rows <- find_rows(core_cpgs, methylation)
matched <- !is.na(core_rows)
cat("Core DMPs gevonden in methylation matrix:", sum(matched), "van", length(core_cpgs), "\n")

core_betas <- methylation[core_rows[matched], ]

# Annotatie voor samples
sample_ann <- data.frame(
  Rookstatus = clinical[colnames(core_betas), "smoking_cat"],
  Geslacht   = clinical[colnames(core_betas), "gender"],
  Leeftijd   = clinical[colnames(core_betas), "age"],
  row.names  = colnames(core_betas)
)

# =============================================
# ORDENEN: rookstatus → geslacht → leeftijd
# =============================================
sample_order <- order(
  factor(sample_ann$Rookstatus, levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")),
  factor(sample_ann$Geslacht, levels = c("female", "male")),
  sample_ann$Leeftijd
)

# Pas de volgorde toe
core_betas <- core_betas[, sample_order]
sample_ann <- sample_ann[sample_order, ]

# Bereken gaps tussen groepen
groep_counts <- table(factor(sample_ann$Rookstatus, 
                              levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")))
gaps_col <- cumsum(groep_counts[1:2])  # gaps na Never en na Ex

# Kleuren
ann_colors <- list(
  Rookstatus = c("Non.smoker" = "steelblue",
                 "Ex.smoker"  = "orange",
                 "Current.smoker" = "firebrick"),
  Geslacht = c("female" = "#E91E63", "male" = "#2196F3")
)

# Gen-annotatie voor rijen
core_clean <- sub("_.*", "", core_rows[matched])
core_genes <- ann[match(core_clean, ann$Name), "UCSC_RefGene_Name"]
core_genes <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(core_genes), ";"), `[`, 1)
core_genes[is.na(core_genes)] <- ""

row_labels <- ifelse(core_genes != "",
                     paste0(core_clean, " (", core_genes, ")"),
                     core_clean)

# Plot — cluster_cols = FALSE want we ordenen zelf
pdf("heatmap_core_DMPs_ordered.pdf", width = 14, height = 16)
pheatmap(
  core_betas,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,                          # niet herclusteren
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",         # rijen wel clusteren
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  gaps_col = gaps_col,                            # visuele scheiding tussen groepen
  annotation_col = sample_ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  labels_row = row_labels,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  main = paste0(sum(matched), " Core DMPs × 316 samples (z-score scaled, ordered by group)"),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100)
)
dev.off()

cat("Heatmap opgeslagen als 'heatmap_core_DMPs_ordered.pdf'\n")
cat("\nSample volgorde: Never (n=", groep_counts[1], 
    ") | Ex (n=", groep_counts[2], 
    ") | Current (n=", groep_counts[3], ")\n")
cat("Binnen elke groep: female → male, gesorteerd op leeftijd\n")
```

```{r}
# === KARAKTERISERING 95 CORE DMPs ===

library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
anno_epic <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)

# Core set (intersectie CT-gecorrigeerd en age-matched+CT)
core_cpgs <- intersect(sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_cc)), 
                        sub("_.*", "", rownames(dmps_matched2)))
cat("Core DMPs:", length(core_cpgs), "\n")

# AHRR check
cat("AHRR in core set:", "cg05575921" %in% core_cpgs, "\n\n")

# LogFC uit CT-gecorrigeerd model
idx_cc <- match(core_cpgs, sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cc)))
core_logfc <- results_cc$logFC[idx_cc]
core_adjp <- results_cc$adj.P.Val[idx_cc]

# --- Richting (hypo vs hyper) ---
direction <- ifelse(core_logfc < 0, "Hypo", "Hyper")
cat("=== RICHTING ===\n")
cat("Hypo:", sum(direction == "Hypo"), 
    "(", round(100 * sum(direction == "Hypo") / length(direction), 1), "%)\n")
cat("Hyper:", sum(direction == "Hyper"), 
    "(", round(100 * sum(direction == "Hyper") / length(direction), 1), "%)\n\n")

# --- Genregio-verdeling (EPIC manifest) ---
idx_epic <- match(core_cpgs, rownames(anno_epic))
gene_groups <- anno_epic$UCSC_RefGene_Group[idx_epic]

# Parse: neem eerste groep per CpG
first_group <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(gene_groups), ";"), `[`, 1)
first_group[is.na(first_group) | first_group == ""] <- "Intergenic"

# Vereenvoudig categorieën
first_group[first_group %in% c("TSS200", "TSS1500")] <- "Promotor"
first_group[first_group %in% c("1stExon", "5'UTR")] <- "5' regio"
first_group[first_group == "3'UTR"] <- "3' UTR"

cat("=== GENREGIO-VERDELING ===\n")
regio_tabel <- sort(table(first_group), decreasing = TRUE)
for (r in names(regio_tabel)) {
  cat(r, ":", regio_tabel[r], 
      "(", round(100 * regio_tabel[r] / length(first_group), 1), "%)\n")
}

# --- CpG-eiland context ---
cat("\n=== CpG-EILAND CONTEXT ===\n")
island <- anno_epic$Relation_to_Island[idx_epic]
island_simple <- as.character(island)
island_simple[island_simple %in% c("N_Shore", "S_Shore")] <- "Shore"
island_simple[island_simple %in% c("N_Shelf", "S_Shelf")] <- "Shelf"
island_tabel <- sort(table(island_simple), decreasing = TRUE)
for (r in names(island_tabel)) {
  cat(r, ":", island_tabel[r], 
      "(", round(100 * island_tabel[r] / length(island_simple), 1), "%)\n")
}

# --- Geannoteerde genen ---
cat("\n=== GENEN ===\n")
gene_names <- anno_epic$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx_epic]
gene_first <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(gene_names), ";"), `[`, 1)
gene_unique <- unique(gene_first[!is.na(gene_first) & gene_first != ""])
cat("Geannoteerde CpGs:", sum(!is.na(gene_first) & gene_first != ""), 
    "van", length(core_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Unieke genen:", length(gene_unique), "\n")
cat("\nGenen:", paste(sort(gene_unique), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
