```{r}
# ===================================================================
# ALLE CONTRASTEN MET CT-CORRECTIE (~ smoking + gender + age + Epi + IC)
# ===================================================================

bereken_lambda <- function(p_values) {
  chisq <- qchisq(1 - p_values, 1)
  round(median(chisq, na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, 1), 3)
}

# --- 1. Current vs Never & Ex vs Never (uit 3-weg model) ---
# fit_cc heb je al: ~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC op alle 316 samples
results_cur_cc <- topTable(fit_cc, coef = 3, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
results_ex_cc  <- topTable(fit_cc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

n_cur_cc <- sum(results_cur_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
n_ex_cc  <- sum(results_ex_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- 2. Current vs Ex (CT-gecorrigeerd) ---
clinical_smokers <- clinical[clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker"), ]
clinical_smokers$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clinical_smokers$smoking_cat)
meth_smokers <- methylation[, rownames(clinical_smokers)]

design_curex_cc <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC, 
                                 data = clinical_smokers)
fit_curex_cc <- lmFit(meth_smokers, design_curex_cc)
fit_curex_cc <- eBayes(fit_curex_cc)
results_curex_cc <- topTable(fit_curex_cc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_curex_cc <- sum(results_curex_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- 3. Ever vs Never (CT-gecorrigeerd) ---
clinical$ever_smoker_ct <- factor(
  ifelse(clinical$smoking.status == "Non.smoker", "Never", "Ever"),
  levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
design_ever_cc <- model.matrix(~ ever_smoker_ct + gender + age + Epi + IC, 
                                data = clinical)
fit_ever_cc <- lmFit(methylation, design_ever_cc)
fit_ever_cc <- eBayes(fit_ever_cc)
results_ever_cc <- topTable(fit_ever_cc, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_ever_cc <- sum(results_ever_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- SAMENVATTING CT-GECORRIGEERD ---
cat("========== CT-GECORRIGEERDE CONTRASTEN ==========\n\n")
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8s\n", "Contrast", "DMPs", "Lambda"))
cat(rep("-", 45), "\n", sep="")
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d %8.3f\n", "Current vs Never", n_cur_cc, bereken_lambda(results_cur_cc$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d %8.3f\n", "Ex vs Never", n_ex_cc, bereken_lambda(results_ex_cc$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d %8.3f\n", "Current vs Ex", n_curex_cc, bereken_lambda(results_curex_cc$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d %8.3f\n", "Ever vs Never", n_ever_cc, bereken_lambda(results_ever_cc$P.Value)))

# ===================================================================
# AGE-MATCHED VERSIES (19-52 jaar) MET CT-CORRECTIE
# ===================================================================

age_range <- range(clinical$age[clinical$smoking_cat == "Current.smoker"])

# --- 1. Age-matched Current vs Never & Ex vs Never ---
clin_am <- clinical[clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Non.smoker", "Current.smoker") &
                     clinical$age >= age_range[1] & clinical$age <= age_range[2], ]
clin_am$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clin_am$smoking_cat)
meth_am <- methylation[, rownames(clin_am)]

design_am <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC, data = clin_am)
fit_am <- lmFit(meth_am, design_am)
fit_am <- eBayes(fit_am)
results_am_cur <- topTable(fit_am, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_am_cur <- sum(results_am_cur$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- 2. Age-matched Ex vs Never ---
clin_am_ex <- clinical[clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker") &
                        clinical$age >= age_range[1] & clinical$age <= age_range[2], ]
clin_am_ex$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clin_am_ex$smoking_cat)
meth_am_ex <- methylation[, rownames(clin_am_ex)]

design_am_ex <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC, data = clin_am_ex)
fit_am_ex <- lmFit(meth_am_ex, design_am_ex)
fit_am_ex <- eBayes(fit_am_ex)
results_am_ex <- topTable(fit_am_ex, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_am_ex <- sum(results_am_ex$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- 3. Age-matched Current vs Ex ---
clin_am_curex <- clinical[clinical$smoking_cat %in% c("Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker") &
                           clinical$age >= age_range[1] & clinical$age <= age_range[2], ]
clin_am_curex$smoking_cat <- droplevels(clin_am_curex$smoking_cat)
meth_am_curex <- methylation[, rownames(clin_am_curex)]

design_am_curex <- model.matrix(~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC, data = clin_am_curex)
fit_am_curex <- lmFit(meth_am_curex, design_am_curex)
fit_am_curex <- eBayes(fit_am_curex)
results_am_curex <- topTable(fit_am_curex, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_am_curex <- sum(results_am_curex$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- 4. Age-matched Ever vs Never ---
clin_am_ever <- clinical[clinical$age >= age_range[1] & clinical$age <= age_range[2], ]
clin_am_ever$ever_smoker_ct <- factor(
  ifelse(clin_am_ever$smoking.status == "Non.smoker", "Never", "Ever"),
  levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
meth_am_ever <- methylation[, rownames(clin_am_ever)]

design_am_ever <- model.matrix(~ ever_smoker_ct + gender + age + Epi + IC, data = clin_am_ever)
fit_am_ever <- lmFit(meth_am_ever, design_am_ever)
fit_am_ever <- eBayes(fit_am_ever)
results_am_ever <- topTable(fit_am_ever, coef = 2, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
n_am_ever <- sum(results_am_ever$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

# --- SAMENVATTING AGE-MATCHED ---
cat("\n========== AGE-MATCHED + CT-GECORRIGEERD ==========\n\n")
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8s %8s\n", "Contrast", "Samples", "DMPs", "Lambda"))
cat(rep("-", 55), "\n", sep="")
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8d %8.3f\n", "Current vs Never", 
    paste(sum(clin_am$smoking_cat=="Current.smoker"), "vs", sum(clin_am$smoking_cat=="Non.smoker")),
    n_am_cur, bereken_lambda(results_am_cur$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8d %8.3f\n", "Ex vs Never",
    paste(sum(clin_am_ex$smoking_cat=="Ex.smoker"), "vs", sum(clin_am_ex$smoking_cat=="Non.smoker")),
    n_am_ex, bereken_lambda(results_am_ex$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8d %8.3f\n", "Current vs Ex",
    paste(sum(clin_am_curex$smoking_cat=="Current.smoker"), "vs", sum(clin_am_curex$smoking_cat=="Ex.smoker")),
    n_am_curex, bereken_lambda(results_am_curex$P.Value)))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8s %8d %8.3f\n", "Ever vs Never",
    paste(sum(clin_am_ever$ever_smoker_ct=="Ever"), "vs", sum(clin_am_ever$ever_smoker_ct=="Never")),
    n_am_ever, bereken_lambda(results_am_ever$P.Value)))

# --- CORE SETS (intersectie CT × age-matched) ---
cat("\n========== CORE SETS (CT ∩ Age-matched) ==========\n\n")

core_cur <- length(intersect(sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_cur_cc[results_cur_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05,])),
                              sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_am_cur[results_am_cur$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]))))
core_ex <- length(intersect(sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_ex_cc[results_ex_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05,])),
                             sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_am_ex[results_am_ex$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]))))
core_curex <- length(intersect(sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_curex_cc[results_curex_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05,])),
                                sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_am_curex[results_am_curex$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]))))
core_ever <- length(intersect(sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_ever_cc[results_ever_cc$adj.P.Val < 0.05,])),
                               sub("_.*", "", rownames(results_am_ever[results_am_ever$adj.P.Val < 0.05,]))))

cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d\n", "Current vs Never", core_cur))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d\n", "Ex vs Never", core_ex))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d\n", "Current vs Ex", core_curex))
cat(sprintf("%-25s %8d\n", "Ever vs Never", core_ever))
```

```{r}
# Recovery per bekende marker
for (marker in names(bekende_markers)) {
  cur <- haal_marker(results_cc, marker, bekende_markers[marker])
  ex  <- haal_marker(results_ex_cc, marker, bekende_markers[marker])
  
  recovery <- ifelse(cur$logFC != 0 & !is.na(cur$logFC) & !is.na(ex$logFC),
                     round((1 - abs(ex$logFC) / abs(cur$logFC)) * 100, 1),
                     NA)
  
  cat(sprintf("%-12s %-6s  logFC cur: %+.4f  logFC ex: %+.4f  recovery: %s%%\n",
              marker, bekende_markers[marker],
              cur$logFC, ex$logFC,
              ifelse(is.na(recovery), "NA", recovery)))
}
```

```{r cibersort-01-load}
# =============================================================================
# CIBERSORT RNA-seq cell type proportions
# =============================================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) tab_dir <- "tables"
if (!exists("fig_dir")) fig_dir <- "figures"

dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

# Bestand kiezen/vinden
cib_file <- "CIBERSORT.proportions.csv"

if (!file.exists(cib_file)) {
  cib_candidates <- list.files(
    path = "C:/Users/Thian",
    pattern = "CIBERSORT\\.proportions\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
  
  print(cib_candidates)
  
  if (length(cib_candidates) > 0) {
    cib_file <- cib_candidates[1]
  } else {
    cib_file <- file.choose()
  }
}

cat("Gebruikt CIBERSORT-bestand:\n")
print(cib_file)

cib_raw <- readr::read_csv(cib_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Dimensies CIBERSORT raw:\n")
print(dim(cib_raw))

cat("Celtypen:\n")
print(cib_raw[[1]])

# Eerste kolom bevat celtypen, kolommen daarna zijn samples.
celltype_col <- colnames(cib_raw)[1]

cib_mat <- as.data.frame(cib_raw)
rownames(cib_mat) <- cib_mat[[celltype_col]]
cib_mat[[celltype_col]] <- NULL

# Transponeer: samples als rijen, celtypen als kolommen
cib_df <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(cib_mat)))

cib_df <- cib_df %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("rna_sample_id_raw")

# R heeft waarschijnlijk X voor sample IDs gezet omdat ze met een cijfer beginnen.
# Bijvoorbeeld X103893.001.305 -> 103893.001.305
cib_df$rna_sample_id <- sub("^X", "", cib_df$rna_sample_id_raw)

# Kolomnamen makkelijker maken
colnames(cib_df) <- gsub("\\.+", "_", colnames(cib_df))
colnames(cib_df) <- gsub("_$", "", colnames(cib_df))

# Check som per sample
celltype_cols <- setdiff(colnames(cib_df), c("rna_sample_id_raw", "rna_sample_id"))

cib_df[celltype_cols] <- lapply(cib_df[celltype_cols], as.numeric)

cib_df$celltype_sum <- rowSums(cib_df[, celltype_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

summary(cib_df$celltype_sum)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_df,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltype_proportions_transposed.csv")
)

cat("Aantal CIBERSORT RNA samples:", nrow(cib_df), "\n")
cat("Celtypekolommen:\n")
print(celltype_cols)
```
```{r cibersort-02-summary}
# =============================================================================
# CIBERSORT cell type summary
# =============================================================================

cib_summary <- cib_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(celltype_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = as.numeric(quantile(proportion, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    q3 = as.numeric(quantile(proportion, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max = max(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean))

print(cib_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltype_summary.csv")
)

p_cib_overall <- ggplot(
  cib_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(cell_type, mean), y = mean)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean CIBERSORT RNA-seq cell type proportions",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean estimated proportion"
  )

print(p_cib_overall)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltype_mean_proportions.png"),
  p_cib_overall,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r extra-checks-01-cibersort-merge-fixed-v2}
# =============================================================================
# CIBERSORT koppelen aan RNA_matched_samples.csv
# Gebruik deze versie als fallback clinical 0 matches gaf
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

if (!exists("cib_df") || !exists("celltype_cols")) {
  stop("cib_df of celltype_cols bestaat niet. Run eerst de CIBERSORT load/summary chunks.")
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Zoek RNA_matched_samples.csv
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

rna_matched_file <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables/RNA_matched_samples.csv"

if (!file.exists(rna_matched_file)) {
  candidates <- list.files(
    path = "C:/Users/Thian",
    pattern = "^RNA_matched_samples\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("Gevonden RNA_matched_samples kandidaten:\n")
  print(candidates)
  
  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    stop("RNA_matched_samples.csv niet gevonden. Run eerst je RNA-seq matching stap of zoek dit bestand handmatig.")
  }
  
  rna_matched_file <- candidates[1]
}

cat("Gebruikt RNA metadata bestand:\n")
print(rna_matched_file)

clinical_rna_cib <- readr::read_csv(rna_matched_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
clinical_rna_cib <- as.data.frame(clinical_rna_cib)

cat("\nKolommen in RNA_matched_samples.csv:\n")
print(colnames(clinical_rna_cib))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check rna_sample_id
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"rna_sample_id" %in% colnames(clinical_rna_cib)) {
  stop(
    "RNA_matched_samples.csv bevat geen rna_sample_id.\n",
    "Beschikbare kolommen zijn:\n",
    paste(colnames(clinical_rna_cib), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id <- as.character(clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id)
cib_df$rna_sample_id <- as.character(cib_df$rna_sample_id)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ID-normalisatie
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

normalize_rna_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("^X", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", ".", x)
  x
}

clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id_norm <- normalize_rna_id(clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id)
cib_df$rna_sample_id_norm <- normalize_rna_id(cib_df$rna_sample_id)

cat("\nEerste RNA ids uit RNA_matched_samples:\n")
print(head(clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id, 10))

cat("\nEerste RNA ids uit CIBERSORT:\n")
print(head(cib_df$rna_sample_id, 10))

cat("\nAantal exacte matches:\n")
print(sum(clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id %in% cib_df$rna_sample_id))

cat("\nAantal genormaliseerde matches:\n")
print(sum(clinical_rna_cib$rna_sample_id_norm %in% cib_df$rna_sample_id_norm))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Merge
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cib_merge_df <- cib_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rna_sample_id_norm,
    dplyr::all_of(celltype_cols),
    celltype_sum
  )

clinical_rna_cib <- clinical_rna_cib %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cib_merge_df,
    by = "rna_sample_id_norm"
  )

first_cell_col <- celltype_cols[1]

cib_merge_qc <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "Rows in RNA_matched_samples",
    "CIBERSORT samples",
    "Samples with CIBERSORT proportions",
    "Samples without CIBERSORT proportions"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(clinical_rna_cib),
    nrow(cib_df),
    sum(!is.na(clinical_rna_cib[[first_cell_col]])),
    sum(is.na(clinical_rna_cib[[first_cell_col]]))
  )
)

print(cib_merge_qc)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_merge_qc,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_merge_QC.csv")
)

safe_write_csv(
  clinical_rna_cib,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_clinical_merged.csv")
)

cat("\nCIBERSORT merge klaar.\n")
cat("Belangrijkste object aangemaakt: clinical_rna_cib\n")
cat("Aantal matches:", sum(!is.na(clinical_rna_cib[[first_cell_col]])), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CIBERSORT-celtypen per rookgroep
# =============================================================================

clinical_rna_cib$smoking_cat <- factor(
  clinical_rna_cib$smoking_cat,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")
)

cib_by_smoking_long <- clinical_rna_cib %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(smoking_cat)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[celltype_cols[1]]])) %>%
  dplyr::select(smoking_cat, dplyr::all_of(celltype_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(celltype_cols),
    names_to = "cell_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  )

cib_by_smoking_summary <- cib_by_smoking_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(smoking_cat, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(proportion)),
    mean = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(proportion, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    q3 = as.numeric(stats::quantile(proportion, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max = max(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cell_type, smoking_cat)

print(cib_by_smoking_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_by_smoking_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltypes_by_smoking_group.csv")
)

# Kruskal-Wallis test per celtype: verschilt de proportie tussen rookgroepen?
cib_smoking_tests <- cib_by_smoking_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(proportion)),
    p_kruskal = tryCatch(
      stats::kruskal.test(proportion ~ smoking_cat)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_kruskal, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_kruskal)

print(cib_smoking_tests)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_smoking_tests,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltypes_smoking_group_tests.csv")
)

p_cib_smoking <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cib_by_smoking_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = smoking_cat, y = proportion, fill = smoking_cat)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.45) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.55, size = 1.3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Non.smoker" = "Never",
    "Ex.smoker" = "Ex",
    "Current.smoker" = "Current"
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CIBERSORT RNA-seq cell type proportions by smoking group",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated proportion"
  )

print(p_cib_smoking)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "CIBERSORT_RNA_celltypes_by_smoking_group.png"),
  p_cib_smoking,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
  ),
  colnames(clinical_rna_cib)
)

# Alleen echte CIBERSORT-matches houden
clinical_rna_cib_matched <- clinical_rna_cib %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[celltype_cols[1]]]))

clinical_rna_cib_matched <- clinical_rna_cib_matched %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CIBERSORT_Epithelial_total = rowSums(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(epi_subtypes)),
      na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    CIBERSORT_Immune_total = rowSums(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(immune_subtypes)),
      na.rm = FALSE
    )
  )

compare_epidish_cib <- clinical_rna_cib_matched %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Epi),
    !is.na(IC),
    !is.na(CIBERSORT_Epithelial_total),
    !is.na(CIBERSORT_Immune_total)
  )

cib_epidish_cor <- data.frame(
  comparison = c(
    "EpiDISH Epi vs CIBERSORT epithelial total",
    "EpiDISH IC vs CIBERSORT immune total"
  ),
  correlation = c(
    cor(compare_epidish_cib$Epi, compare_epidish_cib$CIBERSORT_Epithelial_total, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(compare_epidish_cib$IC, compare_epidish_cib$CIBERSORT_Immune_total, use = "complete.obs")
  ),
  n = nrow(compare_epidish_cib)
)

print(cib_epidish_cor)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_epidish_cor,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_vs_EpiDISH_correlations_FIXED.csv")
)

cib_subtype_correlations <- purrr::map_dfr(celltype_cols, function(ct) {
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    cor_with_EpiDISH_Epi = cor(compare_epidish_cib[[ct]], compare_epidish_cib$Epi, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor_with_EpiDISH_IC = cor(compare_epidish_cib[[ct]], compare_epidish_cib$IC, use = "complete.obs")
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(cor_with_EpiDISH_Epi)))

print(cib_subtype_correlations)

safe_write_csv(
  cib_subtype_correlations,
  file.path(tab_dir, "CIBERSORT_subtype_correlations_with_EpiDISH_FIXED.csv")
)

p_epi_compare <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  compare_epidish_cib,
  ggplot2::aes(x = Epi, y = CIBERSORT_Epithelial_total, color = smoking_cat)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "EpiDISH Epi vs CIBERSORT epithelial total",
    subtitle = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(cib_epidish_cor$correlation[1], 3),
                      "; n = ", nrow(compare_epidish_cib)),
    x = "EpiDISH epithelial proportion",
    y = "CIBERSORT RNA epithelial total",
    color = "Smoking status"
  )

print(p_epi_compare)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "CIBERSORT_vs_EpiDISH_Epi_scatter_FIXED.png"),
  p_epi_compare,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

p_ic_compare <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  compare_epidish_cib,
  ggplot2::aes(x = IC, y = CIBERSORT_Immune_total, color = smoking_cat)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(

print(p_ic_compare)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================

volcano_df <- as.data.frame(primary_results)

volcano_df <- volcano_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
    significant = adj.P.Val < 0.05,
    suffix = ifelse(grepl("_", CpG), sub("^.*_", "", CpG), "no_suffix")
  )

stripe_hits <- volcano_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significant,
    logFC > 0.075,
    logFC < 0.115,
    neg_log10_p > 4
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(neg_log10_p))

cat("Aantal CpGs in volcano stripe:", nrow(stripe_hits), "\n")

safe_write_csv(
  stripe_hits,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_hits.csv")
)

stripe_summary <- stripe_hits %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_rows = dplyr::n(),
    n_unique_CpG_clean = dplyr::n_distinct(CpG_clean),
    n_unique_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(Gene),
    n_chromosomes = dplyr::n_distinct(Chr),
    median_logFC = median(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_logFC = min(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_logFC = max(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_neg_log10_p = median(neg_log10_p, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(stripe_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  stripe_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_summary.csv")
)

stripe_suffix <- stripe_hits %>%
  dplyr::count(suffix, sort = TRUE)

stripe_chr <- stripe_hits %>%
  dplyr::count(Chr, sort = TRUE)

stripe_gene <- stripe_hits %>%
  dplyr::count(Gene, sort = TRUE)

print(stripe_suffix)
print(stripe_chr)
print(head(stripe_gene, 30))

safe_write_csv(stripe_suffix, file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_suffix_counts.csv"))
safe_write_csv(stripe_chr, file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_chr_counts.csv"))
safe_write_csv(stripe_gene, file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_gene_counts.csv"))

p_stripe <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  stripe_hits,
  ggplot2::aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Isolated significant CpGs in the right-side volcano stripe",
    x = "Estimated methylation difference",
    y = "-log10(P-value)"
  )

if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_stripe <- p_stripe +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", CpG_clean, Gene)),
      max.overlaps = 30,
      size = 3
    )
}

print(p_stripe)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "VOLCANO_suspicious_right_stripe_isolated.png"),
  p_stripe,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
volcano_df <- volcano_df %>%

  dplyr::filter(significant) %>%
  dplyr::count(suffix, name = "dmp_n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dmp_pct = 100 * dmp_n / sum(dmp_n))

  dplyr::mutate(stripe_pct = 100 * stripe_n / sum(stripe_n))

suffix_comparison <- suffix_background %>%
  dplyr::full_join(suffix_dmps, by = "suffix") %>%
  dplyr::full_join(suffix_stripe, by = "suffix") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    background_n = tidyr::replace_na(background_n, 0),
    dmp_n = tidyr::replace_na(dmp_n, 0),
    stripe_n = tidyr::replace_na(stripe_n, 0),
    background_pct = tidyr::replace_na(background_pct, 0),
    dmp_pct = tidyr::replace_na(dmp_pct, 0),
    stripe_pct = tidyr::replace_na(stripe_pct, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(stripe_n))

print(suffix_comparison)

safe_write_csv(
  suffix_comparison,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_stripe_suffix_vs_background_comparison.csv")
)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("fig_dir")) {
  fig_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/figures"
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", x)
}

primary_all_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_primary_all_results.csv")

volcano_df <- readr::read_csv(primary_all_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  as.data.frame()

cat("Aantal rijen in volcano input:", nrow(volcano_df), "\n")

if (!"CpG" %in% colnames(volcano_df)) {
  volcano_df$CpG <- rownames(volcano_df)
}

if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(volcano_df)) {
  volcano_df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(volcano_df$CpG)
}

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(volcano_df)) {
  volcano_df$Gene <- NA_character_
}

volcano_df <- volcano_df %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
    significant = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  )

# Controle: dit moet rond 370 zijn
cat("Aantal FDR-significante probe-rijen:", sum(volcano_df$significant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Aantal unieke significante CpG_clean:", n_distinct(volcano_df$CpG_clean[volcano_df$significant]), "\n")

# Stripe-selectie: pas eventueel licht aan
stripe_hits <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(
    significant,
    logFC >= 0.075,
    logFC <= 0.115,
    neg_log10_p >= 4.5
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log10_p))

cat("Aantal stripe hits:", nrow(stripe_hits), "\n")
print(stripe_hits[, c("CpG", "CpG_clean", "Gene", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")])

volcano_df <- volcano_df %>%
  mutate(
    stripe_hit = CpG %in% stripe_hits$CpG
  )

write.csv(
  stripe_hits,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_right_stripe_hits_checked_against_original.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Volcano opnieuw plotten zoals in je presentatie
p_volcano_original_check <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(volcano_df, !significant),
    color = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(volcano_df, significant & !stripe_hit),
    color = "firebrick",
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(volcano_df, stripe_hit),
    color = "blue",
    alpha = 1,
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(1e-5), linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(5e-8), linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.075, 0.115), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot — Current vs Never, CT-corrected",
    subtitle = "Blue points = selected right-side stripe CpGs",
    x = "logFC / estimated methylation difference",
    y = expression(-log[10](p))
  )

if (requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_volcano_original_check <- p_volcano_original_check +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(volcano_df, stripe_hit),
      aes(label = ifelse(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", CpG_clean, Gene)),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 30
    )
}

print(p_volcano_original_check)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "VOLCANO_original_style_with_right_stripe_highlighted.png"),
  p_volcano_original_check,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Robustness check voor rood omcirkelde volcano-cluster
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", x)
}

# Check of cluster bestaat
if (!exists("circled_cluster_hits_strict")) {
  cluster_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_hits_STRICT.csv")
  
  if (!file.exists(cluster_file)) {
    stop("circled_cluster_hits_strict bestaat niet en CSV is niet gevonden.")
  }
  
  circled_cluster_hits_strict <- readr::read_csv(cluster_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

cluster_cpgs <- unique(circled_cluster_hits_strict$CpG_clean)

cat("Aantal CpGs in rood cluster:", length(cluster_cpgs), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 1. Overlap met age-matched CT DMPs
# =============================================================================

age_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_age_matched_CT_DMPs_FDR05.csv")

if (file.exists(age_file)) {
  
  age_dmps <- readr::read_csv(age_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(age_dmps)) {
    if ("CpG" %in% colnames(age_dmps)) {
      age_dmps$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(age_dmps$CpG)
    } else {
      age_dmps$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(rownames(age_dmps))
    }
  }
  
  age_cpgs <- unique(age_dmps$CpG_clean)
  
  cluster_age_overlap <- intersect(cluster_cpgs, age_cpgs)
  
  cat("Cluster overlap met age-matched CT:", length(cluster_age_overlap), "/", length(cluster_cpgs), "\n")
  cat("Percentage:", round(100 * length(cluster_age_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 1), "%\n")
  
} else {
  cluster_age_overlap <- character(0)
  warning("Age-matched DMP bestand niet gevonden.")
}

# =============================================================================
# 2. Overlap met chip-adjusted model
# =============================================================================

chip_results <- NULL

if (exists("fit_chip")) {
  chip_results <- as.data.frame(fit_chip$results)
  cat("Chip-results gebruikt uit object fit_chip.\n")
} else {
  possible_chip_files <- c(
    file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_chip_all_results.csv"),
    file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_primary_chip_all_results.csv"),
    file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_chip_DMPs_FDR05.csv")
  )
  
  existing_chip_files <- possible_chip_files[file.exists(possible_chip_files)]
  
  if (length(existing_chip_files) > 0) {
    chip_results <- readr::read_csv(existing_chip_files[1], show_col_types = FALSE)
    cat("Chip-results gebruikt uit bestand:", existing_chip_files[1], "\n")
  }
}

if (!is.null(chip_results)) {
  
  if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(chip_results)) {
    if ("CpG" %in% colnames(chip_results)) {
      chip_results$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(chip_results$CpG)
    } else {
      chip_results$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(rownames(chip_results))
    }
  }
  
  chip_dmps <- chip_results %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)
  
  chip_cpgs <- unique(chip_dmps$CpG_clean)
  cluster_chip_overlap <- intersect(cluster_cpgs, chip_cpgs)
  
  cat("Cluster overlap met chip-adjusted DMPs:", length(cluster_chip_overlap), "/", length(cluster_cpgs), "\n")
  cat("Percentage:", round(100 * length(cluster_chip_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 1), "%\n")
  
} else {
  cluster_chip_overlap <- character(0)
  warning("Geen chip-adjusted results gevonden. Sla chip-overlap over.")
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. Liggen chr1 CpGs lokaal bij elkaar of verspreid?
# =============================================================================

cluster_chr1 <- circled_cluster_hits_strict %>%
  filter(Chr == "chr1") %>%
  arrange(Pos) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_previous = Pos - lag(Pos)
  )

cat("Aantal cluster-CpGs op chr1:", nrow(cluster_chr1), "\n")

if (nrow(cluster_chr1) > 0) {
  cat("Chr1 positie range:", min(cluster_chr1$Pos, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(cluster_chr1$Pos, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Median distance chr1:", median(cluster_chr1$distance_to_previous, na.rm = TRUE), "bp\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# 4. Samenvatting opslaan
# =============================================================================

cluster_robustness_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "cluster_n_CpGs",
    "overlap_with_age_matched_CT_n",
    "overlap_with_age_matched_CT_pct",
    "overlap_with_chip_adjusted_n",
    "overlap_with_chip_adjusted_pct",
    "cluster_chr1_n",
    "cluster_chr1_median_distance_bp"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(cluster_cpgs),
    length(cluster_age_overlap),
    round(100 * length(cluster_age_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 2),
    length(cluster_chip_overlap),
    round(100 * length(cluster_chip_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 2),
    nrow(cluster_chr1),
    ifelse(nrow(cluster_chr1) > 1, median(cluster_chr1$distance_to_previous, na.rm = TRUE), NA)
  )
)

print(cluster_robustness_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  cluster_robustness_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_robustness_summary.csv")
)

safe_write_csv(
  cluster_chr1,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_chr1_positions.csv")
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Chip-adjusted EWAS + overlap met rood omcirkelde volcano-cluster
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(limma)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", x)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check of rood cluster bestaat
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("circled_cluster_hits_strict")) {
  cluster_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_hits_STRICT.csv")
  
  if (!file.exists(cluster_file)) {
    stop("circled_cluster_hits_strict bestaat niet en CSV is niet gevonden.")
  }
  
  circled_cluster_hits_strict <- readr::read_csv(cluster_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(circled_cluster_hits_strict)) {
  circled_cluster_hits_strict$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(circled_cluster_hits_strict$CpG)
}

cluster_cpgs <- unique(circled_cluster_hits_strict$CpG_clean)

cat("Aantal CpGs in rood omcirkelde cluster:", length(cluster_cpgs), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clinical voorbereiden
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

clinical_chip <- as.data.frame(clinical)

if (!"sample_id" %in% colnames(clinical_chip)) {
  clinical_chip$sample_id <- rownames(clinical_chip)
}

rownames(clinical_chip) <- clinical_chip$sample_id

# Check/maak chip_id
if (!"chip_id" %in% colnames(clinical_chip)) {
  
  possible_chip_cols <- intersect(
    c("chip", "Chip", "CHIP", "Sentrix_ID", "SentrixID", "array", "Array", "slide", "Slide"),
    colnames(clinical_chip)
  )
  
  if (length(possible_chip_cols) > 0) {
    clinical_chip$chip_id <- clinical_chip[[possible_chip_cols[1]]]
    cat("chip_id gemaakt uit kolom:", possible_chip_cols[1], "\n")
  } else if ("meth_file_id" %in% colnames(clinical_chip)) {
    clinical_chip$chip_id <- sub("_R[0-9]+C[0-9]+$", "", clinical_chip$meth_file_id)
    cat("chip_id gemaakt uit meth_file_id.\n")
  } else if ("methylation_sample_id" %in% colnames(clinical_chip)) {
    clinical_chip$chip_id <- sub("_R[0-9]+C[0-9]+$", "", clinical_chip$methylation_sample_id)
    cat("chip_id gemaakt uit methylation_sample_id.\n")
  } else {
    stop(
      "Geen chip_id kolom gevonden en chip_id kon niet automatisch worden afgeleid. ",
      "Check colnames(clinical)."
    )
  }
}

clinical_chip$chip_id <- droplevels(factor(clinical_chip$chip_id))
clinical_chip$smoking_cat <- droplevels(factor(
  clinical_chip$smoking_cat,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")
))
clinical_chip$gender <- droplevels(factor(clinical_chip$gender))

cat("Aantal chip levels:", nlevels(clinical_chip$chip_id), "\n")
print(table(clinical_chip$chip_id))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Samples alignen tussen methylation en clinical
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_ids <- intersect(rownames(clinical_chip), colnames(methylation))

clinical_chip <- clinical_chip[sample_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meth_chip <- methylation[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(clinical_chip), colnames(meth_chip)))

cat("Samples in chip-adjusted EWAS:", nrow(clinical_chip), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Design matrix + diagnostiek
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

design_chip <- model.matrix(
  ~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC + chip_id,
  data = clinical_chip
)

cat("Design columns:\n")
print(colnames(design_chip))

if (!"smoking_catCurrent.smoker" %in% colnames(design_chip)) {
  stop("Coefficient smoking_catCurrent.smoker niet gevonden. Check smoking_cat factor levels.")
}

chip_design_diag <- data.frame(
  model = "Chip-adjusted: smoking + age + sex + Epi + IC + chip_id",
  n_samples = nrow(design_chip),
  n_coefficients = ncol(design_chip),
  rank = qr(design_chip)$rank,
  full_rank = qr(design_chip)$rank == ncol(design_chip),
  kappa = kappa(design_chip)
)

print(chip_design_diag)

safe_write_csv(
  chip_design_diag,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_cluster_chip_model_design_diagnostics.csv")
)

if (!chip_design_diag$full_rank) {
  warning("Chip-adjusted design matrix is niet full-rank. Resultaten voorzichtig interpreteren.")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Chip-adjusted EWAS fitten
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Start chip-adjusted limma model...\n")

fit_chip_new <- limma::lmFit(meth_chip, design_chip)
fit_chip_new <- limma::eBayes(fit_chip_new)

results_chip_new <- limma::topTable(
  fit_chip_new,
  coef = "smoking_catCurrent.smoker",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "none"
)

results_chip_new <- as.data.frame(results_chip_new)

results_chip_new$CpG <- rownames(results_chip_new)
results_chip_new$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(results_chip_new$CpG)

chip_dmps_new <- results_chip_new %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)

cat("Chip-adjusted DMPs FDR < 0.05:", nrow(chip_dmps_new), "\n")
cat("Chip-adjusted unieke CpGs FDR < 0.05:", dplyr::n_distinct(chip_dmps_new$CpG_clean), "\n")

safe_write_csv(
  results_chip_new,
  file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_chip_adjusted_all_results.csv")
)

safe_write_csv(
  chip_dmps_new,
  file.path(tab_dir, "EWAS_chip_adjusted_DMPs_FDR05.csv")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Overlap rood cluster met chip-adjusted DMPs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

chip_cpgs <- unique(chip_dmps_new$CpG_clean)
cluster_chip_overlap <- intersect(cluster_cpgs, chip_cpgs)

cat("\nOverlap rood cluster met chip-adjusted DMPs:\n")
cat(length(cluster_chip_overlap), "/", length(cluster_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Percentage:", round(100 * length(cluster_chip_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 1), "%\n")

cluster_chip_overlap_table <- circled_cluster_hits_strict %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_chip_adjusted_DMPs = CpG_clean %in% cluster_chip_overlap
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    results_chip_new %>%
      dplyr::select(
        CpG_clean,
        chip_logFC = logFC,
        chip_P.Value = P.Value,
        chip_adj.P.Val = adj.P.Val
      ),
    by = "CpG_clean"
  )

safe_write_csv(
  cluster_chip_overlap_table,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_chip_overlap_details.csv")
)

cluster_chip_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "red_cluster_n_CpGs",
    "chip_adjusted_DMPs_n",
    "red_cluster_overlap_with_chip_n",
    "red_cluster_overlap_with_chip_pct",
    "median_primary_logFC_red_cluster",
    "median_chip_logFC_red_cluster",
    "cor_primary_vs_chip_logFC_red_cluster"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(cluster_cpgs),
    length(chip_cpgs),
    length(cluster_chip_overlap),
    round(100 * length(cluster_chip_overlap) / length(cluster_cpgs), 2),
    median(cluster_chip_overlap_table$logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(cluster_chip_overlap_table$chip_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    cor(
      cluster_chip_overlap_table$logFC,
      cluster_chip_overlap_table$chip_logFC,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )
)

print(cluster_chip_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  cluster_chip_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "VOLCANO_red_circled_cluster_chip_overlap_summary.csv")
)
```

The visually apparent upper-right cluster in the primary volcano plot consisted of 91 hypermethylated CpGs with highly similar effect sizes. Although 40 of these CpGs remained FDR-significant after chip adjustment, none overlapped with the age-matched CT DMP set. In addition, the median effect size decreased after chip adjustment and the correlation between primary and chip-adjusted effect sizes within this subset was low. Therefore, this cluster was considered model-sensitive rather than part of the most robust smoking-associated methylation signature. The cluster was retained as a QC observation, but biological interpretation was focused on the core DMPs that were robust across primary and age-matched analyses.


```{r final-extra-00-helpers}

# =============================================================================
# FINAL EXTRA CHECKS — helpers en outputmappen
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(purrr)

tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
fig_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/figures"

dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
  invisible(path)
}

clean_cpg_id <- function(x) {
  sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

get_cpg_column <- function(df) {
  if ("CpG_clean" %in% colnames(df)) return(df$CpG_clean)
  if ("CpG" %in% colnames(df)) return(clean_cpg_id(df$CpG))
  return(clean_cpg_id(rownames(df)))
}

add_basic_annotation <- function(df, anno_obj) {
  if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(df)) {
    if ("CpG" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(df$CpG)
    } else {
      df$CpG <- rownames(df)
      df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(df$CpG)
    }
  }
  
  idx <- match(df$CpG_clean, rownames(anno_obj))
  
  if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Gene <- gsub(";.*", "", anno_obj$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx])
  }
  
  if (!"Chr" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Chr <- anno_obj$chr[idx]
  }
  
  if (!"Pos" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Pos <- anno_obj$pos[idx]
  }
  
  if (!"Island" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$Island <- anno_obj$Relation_to_Island[idx]
  }
  
  df
}

cat("Helpers klaar.\n")
```

```{r final-extra-01-background-universe}
# =============================================================================
# Background / universe QC
# Background = alle unieke CpG_clean IDs die echt getest zijn in primaire EWAS
# =============================================================================

if (!exists("results_cc")) {
  stop("results_cc bestaat niet. Run eerst het primaire CT-gecorrigeerde EWAS-model.")
}

primary_results_bg <- as.data.frame(results_cc)
primary_results_bg$CpG <- rownames(primary_results_bg)
primary_results_bg$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(primary_results_bg$CpG)

# Alleen CpGs met geldige P.Value tellen als getest
background_cpgs <- primary_results_bg %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(P.Value)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(CpG_clean) %>%
  unique()

primary_dmp_cpgs <- if (exists("dmps_cc")) {
  unique(clean_cpg_id(rownames(dmps_cc)))
} else {
  primary_results_bg %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::pull(CpG_clean) %>%
    unique()
}

age_matched_cpgs <- if (exists("dmps_matched2")) {
  unique(clean_cpg_id(rownames(dmps_matched2)))
} else {
  character(0)
}

core_cpgs <- if (exists("final_df2") && "CpG" %in% colnames(final_df2)) {
  unique(clean_cpg_id(final_df2$CpG))
} else if (exists("core_dmps")) {
  unique(get_cpg_column(core_dmps))
} else {
  intersect(primary_dmp_cpgs, age_matched_cpgs)
}

background_qc <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "n_tested_CpGs_background",
    "n_primary_DMP_unique_CpGs",
    "n_age_matched_DMP_unique_CpGs",
    "n_core_DMP_unique_CpGs",
    "primary_DMPs_in_background",
    "age_matched_DMPs_in_background",
    "core_DMPs_in_background",
    "primary_DMPs_not_in_background",
    "age_matched_DMPs_not_in_background",
    "core_DMPs_not_in_background"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(background_cpgs),
    length(primary_dmp_cpgs),
    length(age_matched_cpgs),
    length(core_cpgs),
    sum(primary_dmp_cpgs %in% background_cpgs),
    sum(age_matched_cpgs %in% background_cpgs),
    sum(core_cpgs %in% background_cpgs),
    sum(!primary_dmp_cpgs %in% background_cpgs),
    sum(!age_matched_cpgs %in% background_cpgs),
    sum(!core_cpgs %in% background_cpgs)
  )
)

print(background_qc)

safe_write_csv(
  background_qc,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_background_universe_QC.csv")
)

cat("Background/universe QC opgeslagen.\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CpG-context enrichment met correcte EWAS-background — FIXED
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Maak background en DMP sets opnieuw als ze nog niet bestaan
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("background_cpgs") || !exists("primary_dmp_cpgs") ||
    !exists("age_matched_cpgs") || !exists("core_cpgs")) {
  
  if (!exists("results_cc")) {
    stop("results_cc bestaat niet. Run eerst het primaire CT-gecorrigeerde EWAS-model.")
  }
  
  primary_results_bg <- as.data.frame(results_cc)
  primary_results_bg$CpG <- rownames(primary_results_bg)
  primary_results_bg$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(primary_results_bg$CpG)
  
  background_cpgs <- primary_results_bg %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(P.Value)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(CpG_clean) %>%
    unique()
  
  primary_dmp_cpgs <- if (exists("dmps_cc")) {
    unique(clean_cpg_id(rownames(dmps_cc)))
  } else {
    primary_results_bg %>%
      dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
      dplyr::pull(CpG_clean) %>%
      unique()
  }
  
  age_matched_cpgs <- if (exists("dmps_matched2")) {
    unique(clean_cpg_id(rownames(dmps_matched2)))
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  
  core_cpgs <- if (exists("final_df2") && "CpG" %in% colnames(final_df2)) {
    unique(clean_cpg_id(final_df2$CpG))
  } else {
    intersect(primary_dmp_cpgs, age_matched_cpgs)
  }
}

cat("Background CpGs:", length(background_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Primary DMP CpGs:", length(primary_dmp_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Age-matched DMP CpGs:", length(age_matched_cpgs), "\n")
cat("Core DMP CpGs:", length(core_cpgs), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Contextfunctie
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

simplify_context <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("N_Shore", "S_Shore")] <- "Shore"
  x[x %in% c("N_Shelf", "S_Shelf")] <- "Shelf"
  x[x == "Island"] <- "Island"
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Unknown"
  x[!(x %in% c("Island", "Shore", "Shelf", "OpenSea", "Unknown"))] <- "OpenSea"
  x
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Background context
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

background_context_df <- data.frame(CpG_clean = background_cpgs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Island_raw = anno$Relation_to_Island[match(CpG_clean, rownames(anno))],
    context = simplify_context(Island_raw)
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Enrichmentfunctie
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_context_enrichment <- function(test_cpgs, set_name, background_df) {
  
  test_df <- data.frame(CpG_clean = unique(test_cpgs)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Island_raw = anno$Relation_to_Island[match(CpG_clean, rownames(anno))],
      context = simplify_context(Island_raw)
    )
  
  contexts <- c("Island", "Shore", "Shelf", "OpenSea", "Unknown")
  
  purrr::map_dfr(contexts, function(ctx) {
    
    dmp_in_ctx <- sum(test_df$context == ctx, na.rm = TRUE)
    dmp_not_ctx <- nrow(test_df) - dmp_in_ctx
    
    bg_in_ctx <- sum(background_df$context == ctx, na.rm = TRUE)
    bg_not_ctx <- nrow(background_df) - bg_in_ctx
    
    fisher_mat <- matrix(
      c(dmp_in_ctx, dmp_not_ctx, bg_in_ctx, bg_not_ctx),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
    
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(fisher_mat)
    
    data.frame(
      set = set_name,
      context = ctx,
      dmp_n = dmp_in_ctx,
      dmp_total = nrow(test_df),
      dmp_pct = 100 * dmp_in_ctx / nrow(test_df),
      background_n = bg_in_ctx,
      background_total = nrow(background_df),
      background_pct = 100 * bg_in_ctx / nrow(background_df),
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_res$estimate),
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run enrichment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

context_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_context_enrichment(primary_dmp_cpgs, "Primary DMP set", background_context_df),
  make_context_enrichment(age_matched_cpgs, "Age-matched DMP set", background_context_df),
  make_context_enrichment(core_cpgs, "Core DMP set", background_context_df)
)

print(context_enrichment)

safe_write_csv(
  context_enrichment,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_CpG_context_enrichment_correct_background.csv")
)

cat("CpG-context enrichment opgeslagen.\n")
```

```{r final-extra-03-raw-beta-heatmap}
# =============================================================================
# Heatmap 95 core DMPs — raw beta values
# Zelfde stijl als oude heatmap: CpG-namen zichtbaar, samples gesorteerd op gender
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Pak exact de 95 core CpGs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("final_df2") && "CpG" %in% colnames(final_df2)) {
  
  core95_df <- final_df2 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CpG_clean = clean_cpg_id(CpG)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CpG_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
} else if (exists("core_dmps") && "CpG" %in% colnames(core_dmps)) {
  
  core95_df <- core_dmps %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CpG_clean = clean_cpg_id(CpG)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CpG_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
} else {
  stop("final_df2 of core_dmps niet gevonden.")
}

core95_df <- core95_df %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 95)

cat("Aantal core CpGs gebruikt:", nrow(core95_df), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Labels maken: CpG of CpG (Gene)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(core95_df)) {
  core95_df$Gene <- NA_character_
}

core95_df$Gene[is.na(core95_df$Gene)] <- ""

core95_df$label <- ifelse(
  core95_df$Gene == "",
  core95_df$CpG_clean,
  paste0(core95_df$CpG_clean, " (", core95_df$Gene, ")")
)

# Houd volgorde uit final_df2/core_dmps aan
core95_cpgs <- core95_df$CpG_clean

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Raw beta-values ophalen
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

meth_clean_ids <- clean_cpg_id(rownames(methylation))

heatmap_rows <- rownames(methylation)[match(core95_cpgs, meth_clean_ids)]
heatmap_rows <- heatmap_rows[!is.na(heatmap_rows)]

beta_core95 <- methylation[heatmap_rows, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(beta_core95) <- clean_cpg_id(rownames(beta_core95))

# Exacte core-volgorde herstellen
beta_core95 <- beta_core95[
  core95_cpgs[core95_cpgs %in% rownames(beta_core95)],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# CpG labels met gennaam toevoegen
row_labels <- core95_df$label[match(rownames(beta_core95), core95_df$CpG_clean)]
rownames(beta_core95) <- row_labels

cat("Dimensie beta_core95:", dim(beta_core95), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Samples sorteren zoals oude heatmap: eerst gender
#    Binnen gender kun je eventueel rookstatus en leeftijd meenemen.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(beta_core95))

beta_core95 <- beta_core95[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
clinical_hm <- clinical[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

clinical_hm$gender <- factor(clinical_hm$gender, levels = c("female", "male"))
clinical_hm$smoking_cat <- factor(
  clinical_hm$smoking_cat,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")
)

# Sorteer primair op gender, daarna op rookstatus/leeftijd
clinical_hm <- clinical_hm %>%
  dplyr::arrange(gender, smoking_cat, age)

sample_order <- rownames(clinical_hm)

beta_core95 <- beta_core95[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Annotaties boven de heatmap
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

annotation_col <- clinical_hm[, c("age", "gender", "smoking_cat"), drop = FALSE]

colnames(annotation_col) <- c("Leeftijd", "Geslacht", "Rookstatus")

ann_colors <- list(
  Geslacht = c(
    "female" = "#F4A6C6",
    "male" = "#56B4E9"
  ),
  Rookstatus = c(
    "Non.smoker" = "#F8766D",
    "Ex.smoker" = "#E69F00",
    "Current.smoker" = "#00BA38"
  )
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Raw beta heatmap maken
#    scale = "none" betekent: echte beta-values, geen z-score.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

png(
  file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_heatmap_95_core_DMPs_raw_beta_gender_sorted.png"),
  width = 2800,
  height = 2400,
  res = 250
)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  beta_core95,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 4.5,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101),
  border_color = NA,
  main = "95 core DMPs × 316 samples (raw beta values, gender sorted)"
)

dev.off()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Matrix en CpG-lijst opslaan
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  beta_core95,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_heatmap_95_core_DMPs_raw_beta_matrix_gender_sorted.csv")
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    CpG_label = rownames(beta_core95)
  ),
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_heatmap_95_core_DMPs_raw_beta_CpG_labels.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Heatmap opgeslagen:\n")
cat(file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_heatmap_95_core_DMPs_raw_beta_gender_sorted.png"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Betere top-CpG boxplots: selecteer op grootste raw beta verschil

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Core CpGs bepalen
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("final_df2") && "CpG" %in% colnames(final_df2)) {
  
  core_df_box <- final_df2 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CpG_clean = clean_cpg_id(CpG)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CpG_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
} else if (exists("core_dmps") && "CpG" %in% colnames(core_dmps)) {
  
  core_df_box <- core_dmps %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CpG_clean = clean_cpg_id(CpG)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CpG_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
} else {
  stop("Geen core CpG-set gevonden.")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Long dataframe met raw beta values voor alle core CpGs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

meth_clean_ids <- clean_cpg_id(rownames(methylation))
sample_ids <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(methylation))

core_box_long <- purrr::map_dfr(core_df_box$CpG_clean, function(cpg) {
  
  idx <- match(cpg, meth_clean_ids)
  if (is.na(idx)) return(NULL)
  
  gene <- NA_character_
  if ("Gene" %in% colnames(core_df_box)) {
    gene <- core_df_box$Gene[match(cpg, core_df_box$CpG_clean)]
  }
  if (length(gene) == 0 || is.na(gene) || gene == "") gene <- cpg
  
  data.frame(
    CpG = cpg,
    Gene = gene,
    label = paste0(gene, " (", cpg, ")"),
    beta_value = as.numeric(methylation[idx, sample_ids]),
    smoking_cat = clinical[sample_ids, "smoking_cat"],
    sample_id = sample_ids,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

core_box_long$smoking_cat <- factor(
  core_box_long$smoking_cat,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Selecteer CpGs met grootste median beta verschil Current vs Never
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

core_box_delta <- core_box_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CpG, Gene, label, smoking_cat) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_beta = median(beta_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(beta_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(beta_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = smoking_cat,
    values_from = c(median_beta, q1, q3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta_current_never = median_beta_Current.smoker - median_beta_Non.smoker,
    abs_delta_current_never = abs(delta_current_never),
    current_median = median_beta_Current.smoker,
    never_median = median_beta_Non.smoker
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs_delta_current_never))

print(head(core_box_delta, 20))

safe_write_csv(
  core_box_delta,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_core_CpGs_ranked_by_raw_beta_delta.csv")
)

# Pak top 8, maar forceer AHRR/CYP1B1 erbij als ze bestaan
forced_cpgs <- c("cg05575921", "cg02162897", "cg20408276")

selected_cpgs <- unique(c(
  forced_cpgs[forced_cpgs %in% core_box_delta$CpG],
  head(core_box_delta$CpG, 8)
))

selected_cpgs <- head(selected_cpgs, 10)

cat("Geselecteerde CpGs voor betere boxplot:\n")
print(selected_cpgs)

better_box_df <- core_box_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(CpG %in% selected_cpgs)

# Labels ordenen op delta
label_order <- core_box_delta %>%
  dplyr::filter(CpG %in% selected_cpgs) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs_delta_current_never)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(label)

better_box_df$label <- factor(better_box_df$label, levels = label_order)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_better_box <- ggplot(

) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.25, trim = FALSE, color = NA) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),

  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Non.smoker" = "Never",
    "Ex.smoker" = "Ex",
    "Current.smoker" = "Current"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Selected core CpGs with largest raw beta-value differences",

    x = NULL,
    y = "DNA methylation beta value"
  )
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("fig_dir")) {
  fig_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/figures"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

if (!exists("add_basic_annotation")) {
  add_basic_annotation <- function(df, anno_obj) {
    if (!"CpG_clean" %in% colnames(df)) {
      if ("CpG" %in% colnames(df)) {
        df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(df$CpG)
      } else {
        df$CpG <- rownames(df)
        df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(df$CpG)
      }
    }
    
    idx <- match(df$CpG_clean, rownames(anno_obj))
    
    if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$Gene <- gsub(";.*", "", anno_obj$UCSC_RefGene_Name[idx])
    }
    if (!"Chr" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$Chr <- anno_obj$chr[idx]
    }
    if (!"Pos" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$Pos <- anno_obj$pos[idx]
    }
    if (!"Island" %in% colnames(df)) {
      df$Island <- anno_obj$Relation_to_Island[idx]
    }
    
    df
  }
}

if (!exists("results_cc")) {
  stop("results_cc bestaat niet. Run eerst je primaire CT-gecorrigeerde EWAS-model.")
}

hla_chr <- "chr6"

hla_end <- 29521756

primary_results_hla <- as.data.frame(results_cc)
primary_results_hla$CpG <- rownames(primary_results_hla)
primary_results_hla$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(primary_results_hla$CpG)
primary_results_hla <- add_basic_annotation(primary_results_hla, anno)

primary_results_hla <- primary_results_hla %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
    significant = adj.P.Val < 0.05,
    in_HLA_DMR = Chr == hla_chr & Pos >= hla_start & Pos <= hla_end
  )

hla_dmr_cpgs <- primary_results_hla %>%
  dplyr::filter(in_HLA_DMR) %>%

  )

cat("Aantal CpGs in HLA-DMR regio:", nrow(hla_dmr_cpgs), "\n")

print(
  hla_dmr_cpgs %>%
    dplyr::select(CpG, CpG_clean, Gene, Chr, Pos, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, distance_to_previous)
)

safe_write_csv(
  hla_dmr_cpgs,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_HLA_DMR_chr6_CpGs_with_distances.csv")
)

hla_dmr_summary <- hla_dmr_cpgs %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cpgs = dplyr::n(),
    n_significant = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    start = min(Pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    end = max(Pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    width_bp = max(Pos, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_distance_bp = median(distance_to_previous, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_logFC = min(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_logFC = max(logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_same_direction = length(unique(sign(logFC))) == 1
  )

print(hla_dmr_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  hla_dmr_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_HLA_DMR_chr6_summary.csv")
)

p_hla_dmr_map <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  hla_dmr_cpgs,
  ggplot2::aes(x = Pos, y = logFC)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(size = neg_log10_p, color = significant),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(

  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CpG map of candidate HLA-region DMR on chromosome 6",
    subtitle = paste0(hla_chr, ":", hla_start, "-", hla_end),
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Estimated methylation difference",
    color = "FDR < 0.05",
    size = "-log10(P)"
  )

print(p_hla_dmr_map)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_HLA_DMR_chr6_CpG_map_logFC.png"),
  p_hla_dmr_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

p_hla_dmr_pvalue <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  hla_dmr_cpgs,
  ggplot2::aes(x = Pos, y = neg_log10_p)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(color = significant),

  ) +
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# DMRcate opnieuw draaien met EPICv2 setting
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(limma)

if (!requireNamespace("DMRcate", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package DMRcate ontbreekt.")
}

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

cat("DMRcate versie:\n")
print(packageVersion("DMRcate"))

clinical_dmr <- as.data.frame(clinical)

clinical_dmr$smoking_cat <- factor(
  clinical_dmr$smoking_cat,
  levels = c("Non.smoker", "Ex.smoker", "Current.smoker")
)

clinical_dmr$gender <- factor(clinical_dmr$gender)

sample_ids_dmr <- intersect(rownames(clinical_dmr), colnames(methylation))

clinical_dmr <- clinical_dmr[sample_ids_dmr, , drop = FALSE]
meth_dmr <- methylation[, sample_ids_dmr, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(clinical_dmr), colnames(meth_dmr)))

design_dmr_epicv2 <- model.matrix(
  ~ smoking_cat + gender + age + Epi + IC,
  data = clinical_dmr
)

cat("Design matrix columns:\n")
print(colnames(design_dmr_epicv2))

if (!"smoking_catCurrent.smoker" %in% colnames(design_dmr_epicv2)) {
  stop("Coefficient smoking_catCurrent.smoker niet gevonden.")
}

dmr_design_diag <- data.frame(
  model = "DMRcate EPICv2: smoking + age + sex + Epi + IC",
  n_samples = nrow(design_dmr_epicv2),
  n_coefficients = ncol(design_dmr_epicv2),
  rank = qr(design_dmr_epicv2)$rank,
  full_rank = qr(design_dmr_epicv2)$rank == ncol(design_dmr_epicv2),
  kappa = kappa(design_dmr_epicv2)
)

print(dmr_design_diag)

safe_write_csv(
  dmr_design_diag,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_design_diagnostics.csv")
)

cat("Start DMRcate cpg.annotate met arraytype = EPICv2...\n")

dmr_annotation_epicv2 <- tryCatch(
  {
    DMRcate::cpg.annotate(
      object = meth_dmr,
      datatype = "array",
      what = "Beta",
      analysis.type = "differential",
      design = design_dmr_epicv2,
      coef = "smoking_catCurrent.smoker",
      arraytype = "EPICv2"
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("EPICv2 faalde met foutmelding:")
    message(e$message)
    message("De DMRcate-versie ondersteunt mogelijk arraytype = 'EPICv2' niet.")
    return(NULL)
  }
)

if (!is.null(dmr_annotation_epicv2)) {
  
  dmrcoutput_epicv2 <- DMRcate::dmrcate(
    dmr_annotation_epicv2,
    lambda = 1000,
    C = 2
  )
  
  dmr_ranges_epicv2 <- DMRcate::extractRanges(dmrcoutput_epicv2)
  dmr_table_epicv2 <- as.data.frame(dmr_ranges_epicv2)
  
  print(dmr_table_epicv2)
  
  safe_write_csv(
    dmr_table_epicv2,
    file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv")
  )
  
  cat("DMRcate EPICv2 analyse klaar. Aantal DMRs:", nrow(dmr_table_epicv2), "\n")
  
} else {
  
  dmr_failed_note <- data.frame(
    issue = "DMRcate EPICv2 failed",
    likely_reason = "Installed DMRcate/DMRcatedata version may not support arraytype = EPICv2",
    action = "Update DMRcate/DMRcatedata or document that EPICv2 setting could not be run in current environment"
  )
  
  print(dmr_failed_note)
  
  safe_write_csv(
    dmr_failed_note,
    file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_failed_note.csv")
  )
}
```
