```{r}
# =============================================================================
# EPICv2 HLA-DMR map plot op basis van DMRcate CpG-level annotation
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

if (!exists("tab_dir")) {
  tab_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/tables"
}

if (!exists("fig_dir")) {
  fig_dir <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean/figures"
}

if (!exists("safe_write_csv")) {
  safe_write_csv <- function(x, path) {
    dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path)
    invisible(path)
  }
}

if (!exists("clean_cpg_id")) {
  clean_cpg_id <- function(x) sub("_.*", "", as.character(x))
}

norm_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(grepl("^chr", x), x, paste0("chr", x))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check dat DMRcate EPICv2 echt heeft gedraaid
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("dmr_annotation_epicv2") || is.null(dmr_annotation_epicv2)) {
  stop("dmr_annotation_epicv2 bestaat niet. Run eerst het DMRcate EPICv2-blok.")
}

dmr_epicv2_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv")

if (!file.exists(dmr_epicv2_file)) {
  stop("FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv niet gevonden. Run eerst DMRcate EPICv2.")
}

dmr_epicv2 <- readr::read_csv(dmr_epicv2_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("DMRcate EPICv2 DMRs:\n")
print(dmr_epicv2)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Selecteer de chr6/HLA DMR uit DMRcate EPICv2-output
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

hla_dmr_epicv2 <- dmr_epicv2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(seqnames_norm = norm_chr(seqnames)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    seqnames_norm == "chr6",
    start <= 33000000,
    end >= 25000000
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(min_smoothed_fdr) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1)

if (nrow(hla_dmr_epicv2) == 0) {
  stop("Geen chr6/HLA DMR gevonden in FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv.")
}

hla_chr <- as.character(hla_dmr_epicv2$seqnames_norm[1])
hla_start <- as.numeric(hla_dmr_epicv2$start[1])
hla_end <- as.numeric(hla_dmr_epicv2$end[1])

cat("\nGebruikte EPICv2 HLA-DMR:\n")
cat(hla_chr, ":", hla_start, "-", hla_end, "\n")
cat("DMRcate no.cpgs:", hla_dmr_epicv2$no.cpgs[1], "\n")
cat("Overlapping gene:", hla_dmr_epicv2$overlapping.genes[1], "\n")

safe_write_csv(
  hla_dmr_epicv2,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_selected_HLA_DMR.csv")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Extract CpG-level annotation uit dmr_annotation_epicv2
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nClass dmr_annotation_epicv2:\n")
print(class(dmr_annotation_epicv2))

cat("\nSlots dmr_annotation_epicv2:\n")
print(slotNames(dmr_annotation_epicv2))

if (!"ranges" %in% slotNames(dmr_annotation_epicv2)) {
  stop("Geen 'ranges' slot gevonden in dmr_annotation_epicv2. Stuur slotNames(dmr_annotation_epicv2).")
}

gr_epicv2 <- methods::slot(dmr_annotation_epicv2, "ranges")

cpg_annot_epicv2 <- as.data.frame(gr_epicv2)

# CpG IDs zitten meestal in names(gr)
cpg_names <- names(gr_epicv2)

if (is.null(cpg_names) || all(is.na(cpg_names)) || all(cpg_names == "")) {
  cpg_names <- rownames(cpg_annot_epicv2)
}

cpg_annot_epicv2$CpG <- cpg_names
cpg_annot_epicv2$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(cpg_annot_epicv2$CpG)
cpg_annot_epicv2$seqnames_norm <- norm_chr(cpg_annot_epicv2$seqnames)

cat("\nKolommen in CpG-level DMRcate annotation:\n")
print(colnames(cpg_annot_epicv2))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Filter CpGs binnen de EPICv2 HLA-DMR-regio
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

hla_cpgs_epicv2 <- cpg_annot_epicv2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    seqnames_norm == hla_chr,
    start >= hla_start,
    start <= hla_end
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(start) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_to_previous = start - dplyr::lag(start)
  )

cat("\nAantal CpGs uit DMRcate annotation in EPICv2 HLA-DMR:", nrow(hla_cpgs_epicv2), "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Match met results_cc voor logFC/P.Value als mogelijk
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (exists("results_cc")) {
  
  res_cc_df <- as.data.frame(results_cc)
  res_cc_df$CpG <- rownames(res_cc_df)
  res_cc_df$CpG_clean <- clean_cpg_id(res_cc_df$CpG)
  
  # Exacte match op CpG/probe-ID
  hla_cpgs_epicv2 <- hla_cpgs_epicv2 %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      res_cc_df %>%
        dplyr::select(
          CpG,
          primary_logFC = logFC,
          primary_P.Value = P.Value,
          primary_adj.P.Val = adj.P.Val
        ),
      by = "CpG"
    )
  
  # Fallback match op CpG_clean, alleen voor ontbrekende exacte matches
  res_cc_clean <- res_cc_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      CpG_clean,
      clean_logFC = logFC,
      clean_P.Value = P.Value,
      clean_adj.P.Val = adj.P.Val
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(CpG_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  hla_cpgs_epicv2 <- hla_cpgs_epicv2 %>%
    dplyr::left_join(res_cc_clean, by = "CpG_clean") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      plot_logFC = dplyr::coalesce(primary_logFC, clean_logFC),
      plot_P.Value = dplyr::coalesce(primary_P.Value, clean_P.Value),
      plot_adj.P.Val = dplyr::coalesce(primary_adj.P.Val, clean_adj.P.Val)
    )
  
} else {
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_logFC <- NA_real_
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_P.Value <- NA_real_
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_adj.P.Val <- NA_real_
}

# Als logFC niet gematcht is, probeer DMRcate effectkolommen te gebruiken
candidate_effect_cols <- intersect(
  c("diff", "betafc", "mean.diff", "meandiff", "logFC"),
  colnames(hla_cpgs_epicv2)
)

if (all(is.na(hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_logFC)) && length(candidate_effect_cols) > 0) {
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_logFC <- hla_cpgs_epicv2[[candidate_effect_cols[1]]]
  cat("plot_logFC gebruikt DMRcate kolom:", candidate_effect_cols[1], "\n")
}

if (all(is.na(hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_logFC))) {
  warning("Geen logFC/effectkolom gevonden. Plot y wordt op 0 gezet.")
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_logFC <- 0
}

if (all(is.na(hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_P.Value))) {
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$neg_log10_p <- 1
} else {
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$neg_log10_p <- -log10(hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_P.Value)
}

hla_cpgs_epicv2$significant <- !is.na(hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_adj.P.Val) &
  hla_cpgs_epicv2$plot_adj.P.Val < 0.05

print(
  hla_cpgs_epicv2 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      CpG, CpG_clean, seqnames_norm, start, end,
      plot_logFC, plot_P.Value, plot_adj.P.Val,
      distance_to_previous
    )
)

safe_write_csv(
  hla_cpgs_epicv2,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_HLA_DMR_CpG_level_map_data.csv")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Samenvatting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

hla_epicv2_map_summary <- hla_cpgs_epicv2 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cpgs_in_map = dplyr::n(),
    dmr_no_cpgs_reported_by_DMRcate = as.numeric(hla_dmr_epicv2$no.cpgs[1]),
    start = min(start, na.rm = TRUE),
    end = max(start, na.rm = TRUE),
    width_bp = max(start, na.rm = TRUE) - min(start, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_distance_bp = median(distance_to_previous, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_logFC = min(plot_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_logFC = max(plot_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_logFC = mean(plot_logFC, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_same_direction = length(unique(sign(plot_logFC))) == 1
  )

print(hla_epicv2_map_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  hla_epicv2_map_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_HLA_DMR_CpG_map_summary.csv")
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot: logFC/effect across DMR
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_hla_epicv2_logfc <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  hla_cpgs_epicv2,
  ggplot2::aes(x = start, y = plot_logFC)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(size = neg_log10_p, color = significant),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.35) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = CpG_clean),
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 2.6,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CpG map of EPICv2 DMRcate HLA-region DMR",
    subtitle = paste0(
      hla_chr, ":", hla_start, "-", hla_end,
      " | DMRcate no.cpgs = ", hla_dmr_epicv2$no.cpgs[1],
      " | gene: ", hla_dmr_epicv2$overlapping.genes[1]
    ),
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Estimated methylation difference",
    color = "FDR < 0.05",
    size = "-log10(P)"
  )

print(p_hla_epicv2_logfc)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_HLA_DMR_CpG_map_logFC_FIXED.png"),
  p_hla_epicv2_logfc,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("\nEPICv2 HLA-DMR CpG map opgeslagen.\n")

  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "CpG map of EPICv2 DMRcate HLA-region DMR",
    subtitle = "chr6:29552975–29554004 | DMRcate no.cpgs = 28 | overlapping gene: GABBR1",
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Estimated methylation difference",
    color = "DMRcate CpG-level significant",
    size = "-log10(raw P)"
  )

print(p_hla_epicv2_logfc_fixed)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_HLA_DMR_CpG_map_logFC_FIXED2.png"),
  p_hla_epicv2_logfc_fixed,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("Gecorrigeerde EPICv2 HLA-DMR map opgeslagen.\n")
```
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Cleaner EPICv2 HLA-DMR plot voor verslag
# Geen verwarrende CpG-level FDR TRUE/FALSE legenda
# =============================================================================

p_hla_epicv2_clean <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  hla_cpgs_epicv2_fixed,
  ggplot2::aes(x = start, y = plot_logFC)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.35) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(size = neg_log10_p),
    color = "firebrick",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = CpG_clean),
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 2.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "EPICv2 DMRcate CpG map of the chr6 HLA-region DMR",
    subtitle = "chr6:29552975–29554004 | 28 CpGs | overlapping gene: GABBR1 | region-level FDR = 3.47e-30",
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Estimated methylation difference",
    size = "-log10(raw P)"
  )

print(p_hla_epicv2_clean)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_HLA_DMR_CpG_map_clean.png"),
  p_hla_epicv2_clean,

  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
DMRcate analysis using the EPICv2 annotation identified a DMR in the chr6 HLA-region at chr6:29552975–29554004. This region contained 28 CpGs across approximately 1.03 kb and overlapped GABBR1. All CpGs showed the same direction of effect, with lower methylation in current smokers compared with never-smokers. Although individual CpGs were not necessarily FDR-significant on their own, DMRcate identified the region as highly significant after smoothing, supporting a regional methylation signal. Because the HLA-region is genetically complex and polymorphic, this DMR should be interpreted cautiously.

All 28 CpGs within the EPICv2 DMRcate chr6/HLA-region DMR showed the same direction of effect, with lower methylation in current smokers compared with never-smokers. This indicates consistent hypomethylation across the region rather than mixed hyper- and hypomethylation.


```{r final-extra-08-dmr-final-summary}

# =============================================================================
# Finale DMR-samenvatting voor verslag
# =============================================================================

dmr_epicv2_file <- file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv")

if (!file.exists(dmr_epicv2_file)) {
  stop("FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs.csv niet gevonden.")
}

dmr_epicv2_final <- readr::read_csv(dmr_epicv2_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

dmr_epicv2_final_summary <- dmr_epicv2_final %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    interpretation = dplyr::case_when(
      seqnames == "chr6" & no.cpgs >= 5 ~ "Robust regional DMR; interpreted biologically with caution due to HLA-region complexity",
      no.cpgs < 5 ~ "Low-confidence candidate region; not interpreted as robust DMR because it contains very few CpGs",
      TRUE ~ "Candidate DMR"
    ),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      meandiff < 0 ~ "Hypomethylated in current smokers",
      meandiff > 0 ~ "Hypermethylated in current smokers",
      TRUE ~ "No clear direction"
    )
  )

print(dmr_epicv2_final_summary)

safe_write_csv(
  dmr_epicv2_final_summary,
  file.path(tab_dir, "FINAL_DMRcate_EPICv2_DMRs_interpreted_summary.csv")
)
```

## 4. Zip maken van tables + figures + Rmd

Pas eventueel de naam van je `.Rmd` aan.


```{r final-extra-11-make-zip}

# =============================================================================
# Maak finale zip van tables, figures en Rmd
# =============================================================================

output_zip <- "C:/Users/Thian/Documents/EWAS_outputs_clean_FINAL.zip"

# Pas deze naam aan als je Rmd anders heet
rmd_candidates <- list.files(
  "C:/Users/Thian/Documents",
  pattern = "\\.Rmd$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Gevonden Rmd-bestanden:\n")
print(rmd_candidates)

files_to_zip <- c(
  list.files(tab_dir, full.names = TRUE),
  list.files(fig_dir, full.names = TRUE),
  rmd_candidates
)

files_to_zip <- files_to_zip[file.exists(files_to_zip)]

if (file.exists(output_zip)) {
  file.remove(output_zip)
}

utils::zip(
  zipfile = output_zip,
  files = files_to_zip,
  flags = "-j"
)

cat("Zip aangemaakt:\n")
cat(output_zip, "\n")
```
